translations.E=±Δ 的理想电极表面函数在本公式中需取阈值极限；请稍移能量并比较两侧，当前点: The ideal-electrode surface function requires a threshold limit at E=±Δ in this formula; shift energy slightly and compare both sides. This point is left blank.
translations.理想电极的实能量迟致边界值；数值 η 仅作用于有限正常区。: Real-energy retarded boundary values of ideal leads; numerical η acts only in the finite normal region.
translations.一维单轨道、无磁场和 SOC 的正常金属—s 波超导结。配对仅在右半无限电极；有: 1D single-orbital normal-metal/s-wave junction without field/SOC. Pairing only in right semi-infinite lead; finite region normal.
translations.Nambu 块为(e↑,h↓)，另一自旋块等价。表中概率按一个入射电子通道，G=: The Nambu block is (e↑,h↓), with an equivalent other-spin block. Probabilities are per incoming electron channel; G=2(e²/h)(1−Ree+Rhe) already includes both physical spins and requires no further factor of 2.
translations.E 相对超导凝聚体的化学势。曲线是零温、固定势与固定Δ近似下的谱微分电导；只有E: E is relative to the condensate chemical potential. Curves give zero-T spectral differential conductance at fixed potential and Δ; only E=0 is strict zero-bias linear conductance. No finite-bias self-consistency, nonequilibrium occupations, or I(V).
translations.Ree+Rhe+Tqp+Aη=1 是准粒子通量守恒；Rhe 的空穴反射在电荷电导: Ree+Rhe+Tqp+Aη=1 is quasiparticle flux conservation; Rhe enters charge conductance positively. Tqp is not charge conductance.
translations.η只在有限散射区产生已报告的人工吸收；它不是实际非弹性散射率。理想超导电极内不增: η produces only the reported artificial absorption in the finite scattering region, not a physical inelastic scattering rate. No hidden broadening is added inside the ideal superconducting electrode.
translations.所有能量和接触跃迁以eV计，电导为S，LDOS按一个Nambu自旋块、每eV；不: All energies/contact hoppings are eV, conductance S, and LDOS per eV for one Nambu spin block. No sheet conductance or 3D conductivity is returned.
translations.正常参考线只把同一器件的Δ设为0，其余参数不变。透射接近1且Δ远小于带宽时才接近: Normal reference sets only Δ=0. Transmission≈1 and gap≪bandwidth are required for near-ideal subgap doubling, not arbitrary barriers.
translations.本实验是常规s波NS结，不包含Josephson相位差、自洽配对、拓扑超导或Ma: This is a conventional s-wave NS junction, without Josephson phase differences, self-consistent pairing, topological superconductivity or Majorana criteria.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须为 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限实: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
translations.NS 结输入必须是 JSON 对象: NS junction input must be a JSON object
translations.扫描终点必须大于起点: The scan endpoint must exceed the starting point
translations.精确超导能隙阈值须用单侧极限核验，当前点不报告结果: Exact gap thresholds need one-sided limits; no result at this point
translations.精确E=±Δ的阈值点留空；请减小能量步长并比较阈值两侧。空值不意味着该能量下实际: Exact threshold points E=±Δ are left blank; refine the energy step and compare both sides. A null value does not mean the actual conductance is zero there.
translations.该能量在左电极电子带外或带边，没有入射电子传播通道；电子电导为零，反射概率不定义: This energy is outside or at the edge of the left electron band: no propagating incident-electron channel. Electronic conductance is zero; reflection probability is undefined.
translations.当前点的η、表面函数或通量诊断未达到预设阈值，请先减小η并核验数值稳定性。: η, surface-function, or flux diagnostics fail preset thresholds; reduce η and check stability first.
translations.本模型不接受 ZXQD0DQXZ；采用零温、固定势、实配对及固定两重物理自旋: This model does not accept ZXQD0DQXZ; it uses zero temperature, fixed potentials, real pairing, and fixed twofold physical spin
translations.有限区域Δ=0；右电极包含实s波配对。: Δ=0 in the finite region; the right electrode contains real s-wave pairing.
translations.两根半无限引线的表面函数取精确实轴边界值。: Both semi-infinite lead surfaces use exact real-axis boundary values.
translations.因空穴电荷与电子相反，向后反射的空穴增加流入超导体的电荷电流。: Because a hole has opposite charge to an electron, a backward-reflected hole increases charge current into the superconductor.
translations.同时比较η与η/2，保留未定义阈值和数值误差。: Compare η with η/2, retaining undefined thresholds and numerical errors.
translations.；采用零温、固定势、实配对及固定两重物理自旋: ; zero temperature, fixed potential, real pairing, and two physical spins
translations.Quanty：原子近似的偏振 XAS 与有限温度: Quanty: Atomic Approximation of Polarized XAS with Finite Temperature
translations.Quanty：2p–3d Slater 直接/交换项与偶极算符: Quanty: 2p–3d Slater direct/commutative terms and dipole operators
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限数: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
translations.输入必须是 JSON 对象: input must be a JSON object
translations.configuration 仅支持 d8 或 d9: configuration supports only d8 or d9
translations.本模块未实现 ZXQD0DQXZ: This module does not implement ZXQD0DQXZ
translations.能量步长较线宽大，请增加采样点或缩小窗口；细峰形可能未充分分辨。: Energy spacing exceeds linewidth. Increase samples or narrow the window; narrow peaks may be unresolved.
translations.当前能量窗口未包含全部 Lorentz 尾部或跃迁线；曲线面积不等于无限窗口积分: The window misses Lorentz tails/lines; curve area is not infinite-window weight.
translations.零外场采用热平衡/简并态等权混合；不会自动生成磁畴、交换场或反铁磁有序。: Zero field uses a thermal-equilibrium/equal-weight degenerate mixture; magnetic domains, exchange fields and antiferromagnetic order are not generated automatically.
translations.单离子 p⁶d⁸/d⁹ → p⁵d⁹/d¹⁰ 原子近似；无配体杂化、电荷转移、晶: Single-ion atomic approximation p⁶d⁸/d⁹ → p⁵d⁹/d¹⁰, without ligand hybridization, charge transfer, crystal magnetic order, or RIXS; not a full experimental NiO/CuO spectrum.
translations.3d F⁰/F²/F⁴ 与 2p–3d F⁰/F²/G¹/G³ 是 Slater: 3d F⁰/F²/F⁴/2p–3d F⁰/F²/G¹/G³ are Slater radial integrals; F⁰ is not old Kanamori U, nor F²/F⁴ one J. Initial/final radial values match; core-hole relaxation is not fitted.
translations.横轴 E=(E_f−Tr H_f/dim H_f)−(E_i−E_i,min)，: The horizontal axis is E=(E_f−Tr H_f/dim H_f)−(E_i−E_i,min), with the final-state barycenter recalibrated for every parameter change. Absolute absorption edges and chemical shifts are not calculated; common F⁰ shifts cancel in these coordinates.
translations.偶极径向积分设为1，曲线为相对强度/eV；Lorentz 参数 Γ 是半高半宽（: Radial dipole integral is 1; curves are relative intensity/eV. Lorentz Γ is HWHM, not an absolute cross section or instrumental response.
translations.± 偏振定义为 (x±iy)/√2，固定沿 z 的传播几何；linear 为 c: ± polarization (x±iy)/√2 fixes z propagation; linear=cosθ x+sinθ z may propagate y. XMCD=I₊−I₋, XLD=I_z−I_x; signs depend on conventions.
translations.SOC 存在时 S 与 L 一般不是好量子数；表中给出期望值而不强行贴完整 LS: With SOC, S and L are generally not good quantum numbers; the table gives expectations rather than imposing complete LS-term labels.
translations.费米行列式中使用反对称化两电子矩阵元；晶场与单电子 Σ l·s 在同一球谐基中构: Fermionic determinants use antisymmetrized two-electron elements;  crystal field /single-electron Σ l·s use one spherical basis.
translations.有芯空穴的末态: Final states with a core hole
translations.偶极跃迁守恒自旋并改变轨道宇称；完整末态空间保留核心 SOC 和 p–d 交换。: Dipole transitions conserve spin and reverse orbital parity; the full final space retains core SOC and p–d exchange.
translations.以数值简并组的平均能量计算 Boltzmann 权重，组内每态等权；T=0 或热: Boltzmann weights use mean energies of numerical degeneracy groups, with equal weights per state inside each group. At T=0 or thermal-energy underflow, use the equal-weight ground limit, independent of the solver’s arbitrary basis.
translations.此关系在径向积分设为1及完整 p→d 壳层下成立；有限窗口的 Lorentz 尾: This holds for radial integral1/full p→d shells; finite-window Lorentz tails use separate analytic checks.
translations.X 的小余群矩阵经限制得到右半连接；自旋分支仅计算本模型的二维 spinor。: Restricting X little-cogroup matrices gives the right-hand compatibility links; the spin branch calculates only this model’s two-dimensional spinor.
translations.Bz=0 时 Γ、X 是 TRIM；±i 镜面态在端点配对，路径内部一般分裂。: At Bz=0,Γ/X are TRIM;±i mirror states pair at ends, generically split inside.
translations.连接只约束表示分支，不单独保证内部交叉；本模型的交叉还取决于 β、η 和能量排序: Compatibility constrains representation branches but does not itself guarantee internal crossings; this model’s crossings also depend on β, η and energy ordering.
translations.所选镜面对称性已破缺：此图仅供零扰动母相参考，不能当作当前能带的有效对称标签。: The selected mirror is broken. This plot references only the unperturbed parent and does not supply valid current-band symmetry labels.
translations.二维方格教学模型：不计算真实材料能带，不提供全 230 空间群相容关系或拓扑指标: Square teaching model: no real bands, all 230  space group  compatibility relations, or topology indicators.
translations.能量为共同任意单位；k 坐标为弧度，晶格常数 a=1。: Energy uses common arbitrary units; k uses radians with lattice constant a=1.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限实: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
translations.本模型的表示限制；E1/2、E3/2 和 D± 为此处定义的局部标签，不冒充 B: Restrictions of this model; E1/2, E3/2, D± are local labels, not Bilbao  space group .
translations.m_xz:(x,y)→(x,−y)，E 基为 (p_x,p_y)；A' 为镜面偶: m_xz:(x,y)→(x,−y); the E basis is (p_x,p_y), with mirror-even A' and mirror-odd A''.
translations.model 仅支持 c4v 或 rashba: model supports only c4v or rashba
translations.镜面对称性已破缺，特征标表与连接图仅表示零扰动母相；当前态只显示镜面期望值。: Mirror symmetry is broken; character tables and compatibility graphs refer only to the zero-perturbation parent. Current states display only mirror expectations.
translations.镜面算符 M=iσy 满足 M²=−I，因此自旋镜面本征值为 ±i。: Mirror M=iσy has M²=−I, giving spinful eigenvalues ±i.
translations.将 E1/2 的特征标 [2,0,−2,0] 限制到 double Cs，与四个: Restrict E1/2  character  [2,0,−2,0] to double Cs; inner products with four1D  character  give D+⊕D−.
translations.沿 ky=0，H=εI−α sin(kx)σy+Bzσz。Bz=0 时分裂为 ε: Along ky=0, H=εI−α sin(kx)σy+Bzσz. At Bz=0, energies split as ε±|α sin(kx)|.
translations.时间反演 T=iσyK 将 k 与 −k 配对；只在 Γ、X 这两个本路径的 T: T=iσyK pairs k and −k; same-k Kramers degeneracy is guaranteed only at this path's TRIM Γ and X.
translations.α=0 的整条自旋简并是额外自旋对称性；不能把所有 k 都称为时间反演不变点。: Whole-line α=0 spin degeneracy is extra spin symmetry; not every k is  time reversal  invariant.
translations.C4v 的 E 表示使用 (p_x,p_y) 基；镜面 m_xz 的矩阵为 di: The C4v E representation uses basis (p_x,p_y); mirror m_xz has matrix diag(+1,−1).
translations.限制到 Cs 后 χE=[2,0]；分别与 A'=[1,1]、A''=[1,−1: Restriction to Cs gives χE=[2,0]; inner products with A'=[1,1] and A''=[1,−1] give 1 each.
translations.相容关系 E↓Cs=A'⊕A'' 决定两个分支的对称性，不决定其能量，也不单独强: Compatibility E↓Cs=A'⊕A'' fixes branch symmetries, not energies or compulsory interior crossings.
translations.沿 ky=0，d_z=β(1−cos k)(cos k−η)。β≠0 且 −1<: Along ky=0, d_z=β(1−cos k)(cos k−η). For β≠0 and −1<η<1, the two mirror sectors cross at acos(η).
translations.加入 δσx 后镜面对称破缺，原交叉处 E+−E−=2|δ|；能带排序改变时不能: Adding δσx breaks the mirror and gives E+−E−=2|δ| at the old crossing. Energy-order indices are not fixed representations through reordering.
translations.非零对称残差可用于观察人为破缺；不应把破缺残差当作求解器误差。: Nonzero residuals demonstrate imposed breaking; do not call them solver errors.
translations.Rashba 自旋分裂与 Kramers 配对: Rashba spin splitting and Kramers pairing
translations.整条路径自旋简并: Spin degeneracy along the whole path
translations.α=Bz=0 时 H=εI，额外自旋旋转对称性使所有 k 简并。: At α=Bz=0, H=εI; extra spin symmetry degenerates every k.
translations.C4v 的二维 E 表示保证 Γ 端点简并。: The two-dimensional C4v E representation guarantees degeneracy at Γ.
translations.δσx 破坏原 C4v，Γ 双重态也分裂。: δσx breaks the original C4v and also splits the Γ doublet.
translations.β=0 时此路径 d_z=0；这是额外参数调谐，不是相容关系强制的内部交叉。: For β=0, d_z=0 along this path; this is extra parameter tuning, not a compatibility-enforced internal crossing.
translations.spin 字段为 <σx,σy,σz>，实际自旋为 ħ/2 倍。: spin gives <σx,σy,σz>; actual spin is ħ/2 times this.
translations.spin 字段仅为轨道赝自旋，不是电子真实自旋。: The spin field is orbital pseudospin, not physical electronic spin.
translations.TRIM 上 T²=−1 保证二重简并。: T²=−1 guarantees twofold degeneracy at TRIM.
translations.Bz 破坏时间反演，原 TRIM 双重态间隙为 2|Bz|。: Bz breaks  time reversal ; the original TRIM doublet gap is2|Bz|.
translations.不同镜面本征值禁止杂化；交叉位置由 cos(kx)=η 决定。: Different mirror eigenvalues forbid mixing; cos(kx)=η fixes crossing positions.
translations.δ 混合镜面奇偶态，在原交叉处打开 2|δ| 的间隙。: δ mixes mirror-even and mirror-odd states, opening a 2|δ| gap at the former crossing.
translations.η=−1 将交叉调到 X；X 的两个一维表示本身不强制简并。: η=−1 moves the crossing to X; its two 1D irreps do not alone enforce degeneracy.
translations.输入必须是参数对象: Input must be a parameter object
translations.当前只支持普通空间群 2、4、19、221: Only ordinary space groups 2, 4, 19 and 221 are currently supported
translations.轨道必须为 s 或完整 p 三重态: Orbitals must be s or a complete p triplet
translations.所选位点不适用于这个群；请选择自动位点或该群预设: This site is unavailable for the group; choose automatic sites or its preset
translations.位点轨道–稳定子计数失败: Site  point orbit – stabilizer  counting failed
translations.分解后维数不守恒: Dimension is not conserved after decomposition
translations.一般 k 的跨纤维空间群乘法律失败: Space-group multiplication between generic-k fibers failed
translations.精选普通空间群的无自旋 s / 完整极性 p 轨道教学模型；未施加时间反演，未计: Selected ordinary  space group  spinless s/full  polarity  p teaching model, no imposed  time reversal  or calculated SOC, magnetic groups, energies, or material filling.
translations.本模块从实空间位点稳定子和完整位点轨道构造表示；这不同于从动量小群诱导整个 k: This module constructs representations from real-space site stabilizers and full site orbits; it differs from inducing an entire k star from a momentum little group.
translations.D1、D2…仅为本次计算的小群编号，不能跨 k 点比较，也不是 BC / Bil: D1,D2,… are little-group indices for this run only, not comparable across k or BC/Bilbao standard labels.
translations.位点轨道及 s/p 的诱导表示不自动是不可约或 elementary；本模块不判: Site  point orbit  and s/p  induced representation  need not be irreducible/elementary; general EBR, Wannier obstructions, topology are not diagnosed.
translations.p_x,p_y,p_z 是固定全局笛卡尔轴下的极性向量；完整三重态在部分位点稳定: p_x,p_y,p_z are polar vectors along fixed global Cartesian axes; the complete triplet is reducible under some site stabilizers.
translations.沿用本站 BC 操作设置；群4的 2₁ 轴为 z，不能直接照搬常见 unique: Uses this site's BC operation setting; group 4's 2₁ axis is z. Do not directly copy k-point names from the common unique-b cell.
translations.这里只指定所研究的空间群作用，不做结构对称性识别；单独绘出的位点轨道可能具有额外: Only the chosen  space group  action is studied, no structure identification; the isolated site  point orbit  may accidentally have extra symmetry.
translations.一般位置二点轨道；BC 的螺旋轴为 z: General two-site orbit; the BC screw axis is z
translations.位点映射不是置换: Site mapping is not a permutation
translations.稳定子：减去整格平移后固定种子: Stabilizer: fixes the seed after subtracting lattice translations
translations.选定 k 的小群作用与特征标: Selected-k  little group  action and  character
translations.小群不可约分解（本次计算的局部编号）: Little-group irreducible decomposition (local indices for this calculation)
translations.位点轨道的晶格匹配不唯一: Site-orbit lattice matching is not unique
translations.2₁ 螺旋本征值 λ_{±}=±exp(−iπ k_z)，相位分支在 k_z+1: 2₁ screw eigenvalues λ_{±}=±exp(−iπ k_z); phase branches exchange at k_z+1
translations.标准标签未确认；已保留通过验证的数值表示。原因：ZXQD0DQXZ: The standard labels are unconfirmed; the validated numerical representations have been retained. Reason: ZXQD0DQXZ
translations.标准标签未确认；已保留通过验证的数值表示。原因：: Standard labels unconfirmed; verified numerical representations retained. Reason:
translations.单自旋的物理时间反演满足 T²=−I 且与 H 对易，Kramers 定理强制二: Single-spin physical  time reversal  has T²=−I and commutes with H; Kramers forces double pairing.
translations.仅诊断有限自旋 Hamiltonian；不把耗散生成元谱等同于能级。: Diagnoses finite-spin Hamiltonians only; dissipative-generator spectra are not energy levels.
translations.被动换基：新基矢=旧基矢×U，A′=U†AU；ρ、H、Q、全部C同时变换。: Passive basis change: new basis=old basis×U, A′=U†AU; transform ρ,H,Q,and all C together.
translations.这是一个或两个自旋1/2的有限模型；S=σ/2 无量纲，H/ℏ系数为rad/ns: This finite model contains one or two spin-1/2 particles; S=σ/2 is dimensionless and H/ℏ coefficients use rad/ns. It does not verify spontaneous breaking in the thermodynamic limit or Goldstone’s theorem.
translations.守恒判据是完整算符 L†Q=0，不能由一条期望值恰好平坦的轨迹代替；逐项贡献可以: Conservation requires full operator L†Q=0, not a coincidentally flat expectation along one trajectory. Contributions can cancel. Norms are Frobenius norms; Q values with different dimensions cannot be directly compared.
translations.耗散为各站点独立的现象学 ↑→↓ 弛豫和z纯退相干；浴通道不由Hamiltoni: Dissipation is independent phenomenological ↑→↓ relaxation/z pure  decoherence  per site; channels do not follow automatically from H symmetry/temperature.
translations.简并按1e−8 rad/ns分组仅供显示；保护结论使用声明的对称算符，不把数值接: Degeneracies are grouped at 1e−8 rad/ns for display only; protection uses declared symmetry operators rather than identifying numerical proximity as symmetry protection.
translations.守恒量实验输入须为对象。: Conservation-experiment input must be an object.
translations.反平行和单重态初态只适用于双自旋。: Antiparallel/singlet initial states require two spins.
translations.当前 Hamiltonian 破坏物理时间反演；不能用 Kramers 定理保证: The current Hamiltonian breaks physical time reversal; Kramers’ theorem cannot guarantee degeneracy.
translations.演化未通过迹、厄米性或半正定校验。: Evolution failed trace, Hermiticity, or positive-semidefinite checks.
translations.至少有 ZXQD0DQXZ 生成的连续旋转: At least the continuous rotations generated by ZXQD0DQXZ
translations.三个坐标轴均无连续自旋旋转；不排除斜轴或其他对称性: No continuous rotations about the three axes; oblique-axis/other symmetries remain possible
translations.单自旋实验忽略 jx、jy、jz 和 gradientZ；S²=3I/4 的守恒: The single-spin experiment ignores jx, jy, jz and gradientZ; conservation of S²=3I/4 is a trivial identity.
translations.时间采样较稀，可能漏掉快速振荡；请增加点数或缩短演化时间。: Time sampling may miss rapid oscillations; increase points or shorten duration.
translations.常量Lindblad生成元矩阵指数；没有密度矩阵归一化或正定性修补: Constant Lindblad  generator  matrix exponential; no  density matrix  renormalization/positivity repairs
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 不属于支持的选项。: ZXQD0DQXZ is not a supported option.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 须为 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限实数: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ.
translations.双自旋 T²=+I 本身不强制 Kramers 配对；全局 SU(2) 对称性可: Two-spin T²=+I alone does not enforce Kramers pairing; global SU(2) symmetry can explain spin multiplets.
translations.双自旋 T²=+I 不强制 Kramers 配对；出现的简并须再检查其他幺正对称: Two-spin T²=+I does not force Kramers pairing; degeneracies need other unitary symmetries or accidental parameters checked.
translations.所选Q对所有初态守恒: Selected Q is conserved for every initial state
translations.当前轨迹Q的变化范围: Range of Q along current trajectory
translations.所选观测量的实际轨迹: Actual trajectory of the selected observable
translations.加入 ε S_z 后的Hamiltonian能级: Hamiltonian levels after adding ε S_z
translations.所选Q的逐项约束来源: Termwise constraint sources for selected Q
translations.Q不显含时间；矩阵恒等式[H,Q]=0保证所有初态的期望守恒。这里不把离散旋转自: Q has no explicit time dependence; the matrix identity [H,Q]=0 guarantees constant expectations for all initial states. Discrete rotations are not automatically equated with angular-momentum conservation here.
translations.耗散系统的完整条件: Complete conditions for a dissipative system
translations.完整生成元的伴随作用决定守恒；各项范数不能代替先求矩阵和再求范数。: Conservation follows the full  generator  adjoint; individual norms cannot replace norm of the summed matrices.
translations.有限自旋能级中需要T²=−I且T与Hamiltonian对易；双自旋的T²=+I: Finite-spin Kramers protection requires T²=−I and T commuting with H. Two-spin T²=+I cannot alone guarantee pairing.
translations.绘图可取 r=√density；这是角分布的可视化半径，不是电子真实径向距离。: Plot radius can be r=√density; this visualizes angular distributions, not actual electronic radial distance.
translations.实基函数符号可着色；自旋迹和简并子空间平均后的密度没有单一波函数相位。: Real basis signs can be colored; spin-traced, degenerate-averaged densities have no single-wavefunction phase.
translations.这是单电子 10×10 d 壳层模型；没有电子填充、Coulomb/Hund 相: This is a single-electron 10×10 d-shell model without electron filling, Coulomb/Hund interactions, multiplets, covalent hybridization or charge transfer. It cannot determine high-/low-spin states, magnetic ground states or actual excitation spectra of multielectron materials such as NiO.
translations.Ds/Dt 是独立现象学能级参数；配体坐标固定为理想几何，不由 Ds/Dt 反推: Ds/Dt are independent phenomenological level parameters. Ligands remain at ideal geometry; Ds/Dt do not infer bond lengths or directly equate their signs with stretching/compression.
translations.分裂参数 Δ≥0 是当前几何中两组轨道的正能量间距；八面体 e_g 高、四面体: Δ≥0 is the positive group spacing: octahedral e_g higher, tetrahedral e lower. No empirical tetrahedral/octahedral ratio is imposed.
translations.简并本征矢可任意换基；主要角密度取同能子空间的平均并对自旋求迹。单个 level: Degenerate eigenvectors permit arbitrary basis changes; the main angular density averages the equal-energy subspace and traces over spin. Orbital weights of individual levels reflect one numerical basis choice.
translations.e/t₂ 投影权重不是电子占据数；有 SOC 或低对称晶场时，不应把父相轨道标签: e/t₂ projection weights are not electron occupations. With SOC or lower symmetry, parent orbital labels are not strict quantum numbers for every eigenstate.
translations.密度图只含归一实球谐的角部分，不含径向波函数、真实电子云尺寸或材料电荷密度。: Density includes normalized real-harmonic angular parts only, no radial functions, physical cloud sizes, or material charge densities.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ d 晶场、四方项与 SOC: ZXQD0DQXZ d-orbital crystal field, tetragonal term and SOC
translations.Δ=Ds=Dt=0 时 j=3/2 四态为 −3λ/2，j=5/2 六态为 λ。: For Δ=Ds=Dt=0, the four j=3/2 states have −3λ/2 and the six j=5/2 states have λ.
translations.独立的线性 E⊗e 绝热模型：一个电子二重态耦合两个无量纲约化坐标，不是上方完整: Independent linear adiabatic E⊗e model: one electronic doublet couples to two dimensionless reduced coordinates. It is not an automatic truncation of the full d⊗spin Hamiltonian above and has no SOC.
translations.Q₂/Q₃ 不是已标定的原子位移或质量加权正常坐标；g与K为教学输入，不反推材料: Q₂/Q₃ is not calibrated displacement/ mass weighting  normal coordinate; g, K are teaching inputs, not inferred couplings/bond lengths.
translations.只对电子2×2矩阵对角化后加弹性能；不包含核动能、振动零点能、动态JT隧穿、温度: Only the electronic 2×2 matrix is diagonalized before adding elastic energy; nuclear kinetic energy, vibrational zero-point energy, dynamic JT tunneling, temperature and multielectron occupancy are excluded.
translations.圆形极小谷来自线性模型的偶然连续简并，不意味着真实晶体有连续空间旋转对称性；高阶: The circular valley is an accidental continuous degeneracy of the linear model, not continuous crystal rotation symmetry. Higher-order coupling/environmental anisotropy can select discrete distortions.
translations.当前 λ=0，SOC 扫描范围退化为同一点；调节 λ 可显示能级演化。: At current λ=0, the SOC scan collapses to one point; adjust λ to show level evolution.
translations.d 晶场、四方项与 SOC: d crystal fields, tetragonal terms, and SOC
translations.每个实 d 轨道的 ↑、↓ 相邻；L、S以ℏ为单位，H_SOC=λ L·S。: ↑,↓ are adjacent for each real d orbital; L,S are in ℏ units and H_SOC=λ L·S.
translations.各点按能量排序，不声称跨交叉追踪同一本征态。: Points sort by energy, without tracking one state across crossings.
translations.解析极小圆未完整落在当前二维显示窗口内；仍报告全局极小值，径向曲线会包含该极小半: The analytical minimum circle does not fit fully inside the current 2D window; global minima are still reported and the radial curve includes the minimum radius.
translations.选定点的电子态简并或劈裂低于数值分辨率；下态轨道权重显示子空间平均1/2，不是唯: The selected electronic levels are degenerate or below numerical splitting resolution. Lower-state orbital weights show subspace average 1/2, not a unique eigenstate.
translations.晶场实验输入必须是 JSON 对象: Crystal-field input must be a JSON object
translations.mode 必须是 crystal_field 或 jahn_teller: mode must be crystal_field or jahn_teller
translations.coordination 必须是 octahedral 或 tetrahedra: coordination must be octahedral or tetrahedral
translations.当前模式未使用另一模型的参数：ZXQD0DQXZ；这些字段已验证，但不进入本次: This mode does not use parameters from the other model: ZXQD0DQXZ. These fields were validated but do not enter this Hamiltonian. The parameters field reports only the parameters actually used.
translations.使用归一实球谐；轨道函数、角动量矩阵与三维图保持同一相位约定。: Uses normalized real spherical harmonics; orbital functions, angular momenta, and 3D plots share one phase convention.
translations.晶场只分裂单电子能级: crystal field  splits single-electron levels only
translations.两种约定都保留五个轨道的能量重心，Δ为所选几何的正间距。: Both conventions preserve the five-orbital energy barycenter; Δ is the positive separation for the selected geometry.
translations.加入四方项与自旋–轨道耦合: Add tetragonal terms and spin–orbit coupling
translations.Ds/Dt分别按指定对角系数加入，SOC允许轨道与自旋混合；时间反演仍保留Kra: Ds/Dt add specified diagonal coefficients; SOC mixes orbitals/spin.  time reversal  retains Kramers pairs.
translations.用子空间平均解释角密度: Interpret angular density through subspace averages
translations.同能子空间平均消除简并本征矢任意换基的影响，角密度积分为1。: Averaging equal-energy subspaces removes arbitrary degenerate-basis choices; angular density integrates to 1.
translations.基组取[z²,x²−y²]，两个约化坐标与电子双态矩阵按明示约定耦合。: Use basis [z²,x²−y²]; two reduced coordinates couple to electronic-doublet matrices through the explicit convention.
translations.K>0使两张势能面有下界；g≠0时原点是两电子势能面的锥形交叉。: K>0 bounds both surfaces; at g≠0 the origin is their conical intersection.
translations.g≠0时方位角在此线性模型中不被选择，极小集合是一圈；g=0时退化为原点。: For g≠0 this linear model selects no azimuth and minima form a circle; g=0 reduces them to the origin.
translations.比较解析极小与显示窗口，不能将被裁剪图上的最低采样点误当全局极小。: Compare analytical minima with the display window; the lowest sampled point in a cropped plot is not necessarily the global minimum.
translations.当前模式未使用另一模型的参数：ZXQD0DQXZ: This mode does not use parameters from the other model: ZXQD0DQXZ
translations.；这些字段已验证，但不进入本次 Hamiltonian。parameters 仅: ; these fields validate but do not enter this Hamiltonian.parameters echoes active inputs only.
translations.当前模式未使用另一模型的参数：: The current mode does not use the other model’s parameters:
translations.理想晶体模型的三维对称操作: Three-dimensional symmetry operations on ideal crystal models
translations.r = A f；f′ = R f + t；Q = A R A⁻¹；m′ = s: r = A f; f′ = R f + t; Q = A R A⁻¹; m′ = s det(Q) Q m, s = −1（with Θ) or+1.
translations.晶格矢量为 A 的列；位置使用分数坐标；磁矩为笛卡尔坐标中的时间奇轴矢量。: Lattice vectors are columns of A; positions are fractional; moments are time-odd axial vectors in Cartesian coordinates.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是绝对值不超过 1000000 的有限实数: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number with absolute value at most 1000000
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是三个有限实数组成的向量: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a vector of three finite real numbers
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是长度为 1–ZXQD1DQXZ 的字符串: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a string of length 1–ZXQD1DQXZ
translations.model 必须是晶体模型对象: model must be a crystal-model object
translations.晶胞数值条件过差；请先采用较稳定或约化的晶格基矢: The cell is too ill-conditioned; first use more stable or reduced lattice basis vectors
translations.operationId 必须对应模型中的一个操作: operationId must identify an operation in the model
translations.只核验给定理想模型中所选的一个操作，不识别真实材料的空间群或磁空间群。: Checks one selected operation of the given ideal model only; it does not identify real-material space or magnetic space groups.
translations.化学对称要求周期等价的同种原子完整一一对应；磁对称还要求变换后的磁矩一致。两种匹: Chemical symmetry needs a complete periodic same-species bijection; magnetic symmetry also needs transformed moments. Matches solve independently.
translations.周期位置误差采用笛卡尔最近晶格像；折回晶胞只用于显示，不把非零平移改称为恒等操作: Periodic position errors use the nearest Cartesian lattice image; wrapping is for display only and does not turn nonzero translations into identity operations.
translations.位置容差为最长基矢长度的 10⁻⁷；磁矩容差为 max(1, 最大磁矩模长) 的: Position tolerance is 10⁻⁷ times the longest basis-vector length; moment tolerance is 10⁻⁷ max(1,largest moment magnitude), in input units.
translations.时间反演不改变位置，会反转磁矩；这里展示经典磁序的变换，不计算量子态的反幺正表示: time reversal  reverses moments without moving positions; this is classical order, no quantum antiunitary representations/Kramers degeneracy.
translations.必须是绝对值不超过 1000000 的有限实数: must be a finite real number with absolute value at most 1000000
translations.必须是三个有限实数组成的向量: must be a three-component finite-real vector
translations.输入必须是有限大小的 JSON 数据: Input must be finite-size JSON data
translations.每个原子必须是对象: Every atom must be an object
translations.每个操作必须是对象: Each operation must be an object
translations.rotation 必须是元素绝对值不超过 32 的整数晶格矩阵: rotation must be an integer lattice matrix with element magnitudes at most 32
translations.rotation 不保持该晶胞的欧氏度量，不能作为刚体对称操作: rotation violates the cell Euclidean metric and cannot be rigid symmetry
translations.timeReversal 必须为 true 或 false: timeReversal must be true or false
translations.晶胞过于倾斜，周期最近像搜索超出教学计算预算；请约化晶胞后重试: Cell skewness exceeds the teaching budget for periodic nearest-image search; reduce the cell and retry
translations.H/ℏ 使用 rad/ns，时间使用 ns；drive 是 Ω 而不是 Ω/(2: H/ℏ uses rad/ns and time uses ns; drive is Ω, not Ω/(2π). The basis is ordered ↑,↓, and relaxation converts ↑ to ↓.
translations.γ₁、γ_φ 为固定现象学速率；每个自旋独立耦合所选 Markov 通道。没有非: γ₁,γ_φ are fixed phenomenological rates; each spin independently couples to selected Markov channels. No non-Markov bath, pulses, real-material fitting, or self-consistent bath feedback.
translations.局部熵含经典混合与量子纠缠贡献；只有整体纯态时，它才是该二分划分的纠缠熵。本实验: Local entropy includes classical mixture/quantum  entanglement ; only a globally pure state makes it bipartite  entanglement  entropy. Two-spin mixed states additionally report partial-transpose negativity.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须为 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限数: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
translations.密度矩阵实验输入必须为 JSON 对象: Density-matrix experiment input must be a JSON object
translations.反平行、单重态和反平行经典混合初态需要选择双自旋实验: Antiparallel, singlet, and classical antiparallel-mixture initial states require the two-spin experiment
translations.密度矩阵未通过迹、厄米性或半正定校验，请缩小时间范围: The density matrix failed trace, Hermiticity or positive-semidefiniteness checks; shorten the time interval
translations.末态密度矩阵的实部: Real part of the final density matrix
translations.热态仅定义初始条件；本地 ↑→↓ 通道不按耦合后 Hamiltonian 的跃迁: A thermal state defines initial conditions only. Local ↑→↓ channels are not constructed from coupled-Hamiltonian transitions and detailed balance, so evolution is not claimed to approach Gibbs equilibrium at the same temperature.
translations.单自旋实验不使用双自旋 exchange 与 gradient 参数；它们不会改: Single-spin experiments do not use pair exchange/gradient; these do not affect this calculation.
translations.时间采样较稀，曲线可能漏掉快速变化；矩阵指数在采样点仍求解同一常量生成元。请增加: Time sampling is sparse and may miss rapid changes; the matrix exponential still solves the same constant generator at sampled times. Add samples or shorten the duration.
translations.常量 Lindblad 生成元；缩放平方矩阵指数，无归一化或正定投影修补: Constant Lindblad generator; scaling-and-squaring matrix exponential without normalization or positivity-projection repairs
translations.1/T₂ = γ₁/2 + γ_φ；仅描述无驱动、无耦合单自旋的横向包络: 1/T₂ = γ₁/2 + γ_φ; only the transverse envelope of an undriven, uncoupled single spin
translations.纯度描述整体混合性；局部熵只有在整体纯态时才等于该二分划分的纠缠熵。: Purity measures global mixing; local entropy equals bipartite entanglement entropy only for a globally pure state.
translations.这是本通道约定下无驱动、无交换单自旋的相干包络率；完整驱动轨迹不必为单一指数。: This is the coherence-envelope rate for a single spin without drive or exchange under this channel convention; a driven trajectory need not be a single exponential.
translations.对B部分转置，累加负本征值的绝对值；适用于本实验2×2系统，不把局部熵当一般混态: Partially transpose B and sum absolute negative eigenvalues. This applies to the experiment’s 2×2 system; local entropy is not general mixed-state entanglement.
translations.非相互作用、相干、弹性、一维单轨道链，左右电极为相同的半无限均匀链；不是任意三维: Noninteracting, coherent, elastic, one-dimensional single-orbital chain with identical semi-infinite uniform leads; not an arbitrary 3D device or complete Kwant port.
translations.G=gs(e²/h)T(EF) 是零温、零偏压极限的两端电导；能量滑块作为所选费: G=gs(e²/h)T(EF) is zero-T, zero-bias two-terminal conductance. The energy slider selects Fermi energy, no finite-bias profile, temperature integration, or contact self-consistency.
translations.每个自旋的电极至多一个传播通道。gs=2 只复制完全独立的自旋通道，不表示已经加: Electrodes have at most one propagating channel per spin. gs=2 only duplicates fully independent spin channels; it does not include SOC, Zeeman coupling or spin scattering.
translations.局域态密度与注入密度按每个自旋、每 eV 给出；bondTransmission: LDOS and injectivity are per spin per eV; bondTransmission is left-incident normalized flux, not finite-bias current in amperes.
translations.eta 是散射区 Green 函数的数值正虚部，带来已报告的人工吸收；它不是物理: eta is numerical positive imaginary Green regularization, causing reported artificial absorption, not relaxation. Reduce eta/check transmission stability.
translations.SSH 的胞内键从站点 0–1 开始；端态与接触共振取决于终止方式、有限长度和电: SSH intracell bonds begin at sites 0–1; edge states and contact resonances depend on termination, finite length and electrode coupling. One zero-energy peak alone cannot prove topology.
translations.能量扫描只给有限采样点，窄共振可能被漏采；当前 eta 比较仅针对选定能量，不能: Finite energy scans can miss narrow resonances; the current eta comparison tests the selected energy only, not convergence of the whole curve.
translations.器件输入必须为 JSON 对象: Device input must be a JSON object
translations.model 必须为 uniform 或 ssh: model must be uniform or ssh
translations.势垒起点与宽度超出散射区；站点编号从 0 开始: Barrier start/width exceed the region; site indices start0
translations.能量扫描终点须大于起点: Energy-scan end must exceed its start
translations.所选能量位于电极带外或恰在带边，没有传播通道；T 与电导取零，局域谱仍可含束缚态: Selected energy is outside or at a lead-band edge, with no propagating channel. T and conductance are zero; local spectra can still contain bound or edge weight.
translations.至少一侧接触为零，两端透射严格为零；孤立或单侧连接的局域态仍可能在 LDOS 中: A zero contact makes two-terminal transmission exactly zero; isolated/one-sided local states can remain in LDOS.
translations.所选能量对数值展宽较敏感；请减小 eta 并重新检查，尤其注意弱接触或窄共振。: The selected energy is sensitive to numerical broadening; reduce eta and recheck, particularly for weak contacts or narrow resonances.
translations.数值守恒或矩阵求解残差偏大，当前结果应先做数值收敛核验。: Conservation or linear-solve residuals are large; first check numerical convergence.
translations.左入射的无量纲正向通量: Dimensionless forward flux for left incidence
translations.必须是有限实数: must be a finite real number
translations.选取在上半平面解析且大能量趋向1/E的物理解；电极带内有有限逃逸宽度。: Choose the physical solution analytic in the upper half-plane and approaching 1/E at high energy; inside the electrode band it has finite escape broadening.
translations.两端各连接一个站点，每自旋一个传播通道；反射由r=1−iΓLGʳ11得到。: One site connects each end, one propagating channel/spin; reflection via r=1−iΓLGʳ11.
translations.gs只表示独立自旋副本数。打开通道不等于每个通道都完全透射。: gs counts independent spin copies only. An open channel is not necessarily fully transmitting.
translations.正虚部引入损失2η|ψi|²；程序核验T+R+Aη=1及每个站点的通量连续性。: A positive imaginary part produces loss 2η|ψi|²; the program checks T+R+Aη=1 and flux continuity at every site.
translations.理想常规立方胞，矢量按行排列，原子为分数坐标。: Ideal conventional cubic cell, with lattice vectors as rows and fractional atomic coordinates.
translations.在给定模型与散射权重下结构因子非零；允许不代表实验中一定可分辨。: The specified model and scattering weights give a nonzero structure factor. Allowed does not imply experimentally resolvable.
translations.f 为用户给定的恒定实散射权重；默认元素数字仅取原子序数作示意，未使用随散射矢量: f is a user constant real weight; default elemental numbers use atomic numbers illustratively, not Q-dependent X-ray form factors.
translations.I=|F|² 为运动学结构因子强度；粉末棒谱只按等 d 求和，不含 Lorent: I=|F|² is kinematic structure-factor intensity; the powder stick spectrum only sums equal-d reflections, without Lorentz/polarization factors, Debye–Waller effects, absorption, instrumental broadening, texture or anomalous scattering.
translations.晶格常数为教学示意值，不能将棒谱视为对应材料的定量实验 XRD；2θ 用一阶 B: Lattice constants are illustrative. The stick spectrum is not quantitative experimental XRD; 2θ uses first-order Bragg conditions and input wavelength.
translations.仅枚举 |h|、|k|、|l|≤ZXQD0DQXZ，同一 ±hkl 对保留一项并: Enumerate only |h|,|k|, |l|≤ZXQD0DQXZ; retain one ±hkl partner and double powder multiplicity. High-angle index cutoffs can miss same-d reflections.
translations.格心/金刚石基底/2₁ 分类只针对已构造预设；自定义结构需列出完整晶胞所有原子，: Centering/diamond-basis/2₁ classifications apply only to constructed presets. Custom structures must list every atom of the full cell; CIF asymmetric units are not expanded and space-group absences are not automatically identified.
translations.数值抵消阈值为 1e-10×max(1,Σ|占据率×f|)；非常弱的非零反射可能: Cancellation threshold is 1e-10×max(1,Σ|occupancy×f|); very weak nonzero reflections can be classified as numerical zero.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须含三个实数: ZXQD0DQXZ must contain three real numbers
translations.cell 必须是行向量组成的 3×3 晶胞矩阵（Å）: cell must be a 3×3 lattice matrix of row vectors (Å)
translations.cell 必须非奇异且条件数不超过 1e6，体积至少为 1e-6 Å³: cell must be nonsingular, condition≤1e6, volume≥1e-6 Å³
translations.scatteringFactors 必须为最多 64 项的元素→恒定实权重对象: scatteringFactors must map elements to constant real weights, with at most 64 entries
translations.晶胞矢量按行排列，原子为分数坐标；所有原子需显式列出。: Cell vectors are rows, atoms  fractional coordinates ; list all atoms explicitly.
translations.F 格心：h、k、l 必须同奇或同偶；混合奇偶时格心相位和为零。: F centering: h,k,l must be all odd or all even; mixed parity makes the centering phase sum vanish.
translations.I 格心：h+k+l 必须为偶数；奇数时两个格点相位相反。: I centering requires even h+k+l; odd values give opposite phases on the two lattice points.
translations.金刚石等权同种原子基底：全偶且 h+k+l=4n+2 时，(¼,¼,¼) 基底相: Equal-atom diamond: all-even indices with h+k+l=4n+2 give(¼,¼,¼) phase−1. This is not every F structure's basis condition.
translations.沿 z 的 2₁ 配对：仅对 00l，平移 c/2 给出 (−1)^l，所以奇数: z-directed 2₁ pairs: only for 00l, translation c/2 gives (−1)^l and extinguishes odd l.

translations.自动匹配最小化母相参考度量中的平方位移总和；不会自动寻找晶胞变换、共同原点或跨元: Automatic matching minimizes total squared displacement in the parent reference metric; it does not find cell transformations, a common origin or cross-species mappings automatically.

translations.原创理想 SrTiO₃ 2×2×2 相容超胞（40 原子），反相转动按 (-1): Original ideal SrTiO₃ 2×2×2 compatible supercell (40 atoms), with antiphase rotations alternating as (-1)^(i+j+k). Displacements are linear small-angle modes, not finite-angle rigid octahedra or fitted/experimental structures.
translations.此参数组自由能无下界；有限绘图区的最低点不是全局平衡态。需要调整系数或加入稳定的: This free energy is unbounded below. The lowest plotted point is not global equilibrium; adjust coefficients or add stabilizing higher-order terms.
translations.b1,b2>0 时四次项在所有非零 Q 上严格正定的条件为 c > -2√(b1: For b1,b2>0, strict positivity of the quartic term for every nonzero Q requires c > -2√(b1b2); positive c has no upper bound.
translations.payload 必须是 JSON 对象: payload must be a JSON object
translations.母相与畸变相必须具有相同原子数；请先建立相容超胞: Parent/distorted atom counts must match; first build compatible  supercell
translations.两个晶胞手性不同，不能当作同一晶胞的连续应变；先显式对齐晶胞基和原子坐标: The cells have opposite handedness and cannot be treated as a continuous strain of one cell; explicitly align cell bases and atomic coordinates first
translations.输入模式线性相关；幅度不是唯一坐标，当前给出 Moore–Penrose 最小范: Input modes are linearly dependent, so amplitudes are nonunique; the Moore–Penrose minimum-norm solution is returned. Reconstruction remains testable, but individual coefficients are not unique physical order parameters.
translations.输入模式非正交，采用完整最小二乘求解；逐列点积通常不是正确幅度。: Nonorthogonal input modes use full least squares; individual dot products generally give wrong amplitudes.
translations.reconstruction_lattice 必须是 parent 或 dist: reconstruction_lattice must be parent or distorted
translations.平移去除使用全部原子的算术平均位移（非质量加权质心）；重构默认不恢复这一原点平移: Translation removal uses the arithmetic mean over all atomic displacements, not a mass-weighted center of mass. Reconstruction does not restore this origin shift by default.
translations.用户提供的已对齐同胞结构与模式；数据来源由用户负责说明。: User-aligned same-cell structures/modes; users must state provenance.
translations.F=(Lp⁻¹ Ld)ᵀ；E=(FᵀF−I)/2；内位移按母相参考度量分析: F=(Lp⁻¹ Ld)ᵀ; E=(FᵀF−I)/2; analyze internal displacements in the parent reference metric
translations.必须是有限数值，不能是布尔值: must be finite numeric, not boolean

translations.atom_mapping 不能映射到不同元素: atom_mapping cannot map to a different element

translations.每个模式必须是包含 vectors 的对象: Each mode must be an object containing vectors
translations.模式不能是零向量或过大；提供维数无关的笛卡尔方向后由程序归一化: Modes cannot be zero or excessively large; supply Cartesian directions without a physical amplitude and the program normalizes them
translations.左手输入晶胞已同步反转第一基矢和第一分数坐标，保留真实手性。: A left-handed cell was corrected by reversing basis1/fractional  fractional coordinates  together, preserving actual  chirality .
translations.真正的全局极小在当前绘图区外；请扩大绘图范围。: The true global minimum is outside the plot; expand the range.
translations.重构幅度绝对值不能超过 100 Å: Reconstruction amplitudes cannot exceed 100 Å in magnitude
translations.核对晶胞基、原点和原子数；在母相真实笛卡尔度量中求周期最短像并匹配同种元素。: Check cell bases, origins and atom counts; find nearest periodic images in the parent’s actual Cartesian metric and match identical species.
translations.晶格给出变形梯度 F 与 Green–Lagrange 应变 E；分数位置变化给: Lattices give F/Green–Lagrange E; fractional changes give reference internal displacements, with optional arithmetic-mean translation removal.
translations.将归一化模式按列组成 B，解 min_Q ||BQ−u||²；检查秩、Gram: Form B from normalized mode columns and solve min_Q ||BQ−u||²; check rank, Gram matrix, and normal-equation residuals.
translations.由 x=x_parent+(BQ)L_parent⁻¹ 重建分数位置；选择母相或: Reconstruct fractional positions with x=x_parent+(BQ)L_parent⁻¹; choose the parent/distorted lattice, retain residuals and export in P1.
translations.枚举原点、两条轴支和混合支；用 Hessian 和必要的高阶项分类，退化连续解与: Enumerate origin, two axial, mixed branches; classify by Hessian/necessary higher orders, and separately report continuous degeneracy/unboundedness.

translations.原子存在等价或近等价全局匹配（平方位移总成本差 ≤ mapping_toler: atoms have equivalent or nearly equivalent global matchings (total squared-displacement cost difference ≤ mapping_tolerance²); provide atom_mapping explicitly rather than choosing arbitrarily
translations.在周期晶胞边界存在多个等长最短像；请显式给出 image_shifts，避免任: has tied shortest periodic images; specify image_shifts to avoid arbitrary directions
translations.非紧连续简并极小：双曲线或直线: Noncompact continuously degenerate minima: hyperbola or straight line
translations.解除中心约束的离散稳定性: Discrete stability after releasing the center constraint
translations.当前粗网格驻点的完整离散能量 Hessian 有负本征值；它在允许壁中心移动时不: The full discrete-energy Hessian of the coarse-grid stationary point has a negative eigenvalue. It is unstable when the wall center may move; a small residual cannot establish free-wall stability. Refine and compare.
translations.中心窗口与两端六格点存在重叠，两个权重不可直接相加，也不能凭中心总权重认定界面局: The center window overlaps the six endpoint sites. Do not add the weights directly or infer interface localization from total center weight alone; inspect the full spatial distribution or increase chain length.
translations.这条有限链的端点尚未接近±δ渐近键序；标出的4tδ是无限均匀体相参考能隙，不是本: This chain's endpoints have not approached asymptotic ±δ bond order. Marked 4tδ is an infinite uniform bulk reference gap, not an established finite-chain gap.
translations.子空间中心区域总权重: total weight of subspace center area
translations.子空间两端六格点总权重: The total weight of the six grid points at both ends of the subspace
translations.x、序参量与自由能均为约化教学单位；κ、β、v不对应已拟合的BaTiO₃材料参数: x,  order parameter , and free energy use reduced teaching units;κ,β, v are not fitted BaTiO₃ material parameters.
translations.固定两端−v/+v并用反对称条件固定壁中心。宽度ξ是tanh尺度；有限网格能量与: Fix endpoints at −v/+v and pin the wall center by antisymmetry. Width ξ is the tanh scale; finite-grid energies differ from the infinite continuous solution through discretization and boundary errors.
translations.求解的是中心约束的静态标量180°壁驻点；小驻点残差不证明解除中心约束后的稳定性: Solves a center-constrained static scalar 180° wall stationary point. A small residual does not establish released-center stability; the mesh breaks continuous translation and requires a separate Hessian check.
translations.未包含静电、弹性、畴切换动力学或真实材料壁能。: No electrostatics, elasticity, domain-switching dynamics, or real wall energies.
translations.未发现负方向（数值容差内）: No negative direction found (within numerical tolerance)
translations.存在负方向：需加密网格/检查钉扎: Negative direction present: refine mesh/check pinning
translations.独立的无自旋、无相互作用SSH界面模型，t和在位势以eV计；sshWidth以键: Independent noninteracting spinless SSH interface: t/potentials in eV, sshWidth in bond spacings, not automatically ferroelectric  domain wall  width.
translations.开放链可能同时有端态和界面态。空间分布必须与能量一起判断，近零能不是界面局域性的: An open chain may have both edge and interface states. Assess spatial distributions together with energies; near-zero energy is insufficient for interface localization.
translations.近零能区取|E|<tδ，显示该子空间投影的对角元，简并态任意换基不改变结果。阈值: Near-zero means |E|<tδ. The displayed projector diagonal is invariant to basis changes within degenerate spaces. This window is not the entire bulk gap; states moving outside have not disappeared.
translations.局域在位势破坏手征对称；有限链两端/界面之间的杂化可分裂近零能级。: Local onsite terms break chiral symmetry; finite end/interface hybridization can split near-zero levels.
translations.LDOS 使用单位面积 Lorentz 线型，η 为半高半宽（HWHM），FWH: LDOS uses unit-area Lorentzians; η is the HWHM and FWHM=2η. It only smooths finite-chain spectra and is not artificial absorption in device transport. Each site’s LDOS integrates to 1 over all energies.
translations.两端六格点权重: Weight on six sites at each end
translations.包含全部选中态，和等于子空间维数: All selected states; sum equals subspace dimension
translations.理想一维双原子纵向谐链的相干一声子模型；参数与散射权重由用户给定，不是 NaCl: Coherent one-phonon model of an ideal one-dimensional diatomic longitudinal harmonic chain; parameters and scattering weights are user inputs, not fits to NaCl, NiO or any material.
translations.完整散射向量 Q 与约化声子 q 不同：Q∥=Q cosθ，q=Q∥ mod 2: Full scattering Q differs from reduced phonon q: Q∥=Q cosθ, q=Q∥ mod 2π/a. Changing the angle changes both momentum matching and longitudinal Q·e projection.
translations.相干权重 bA/bB 是有符号的相对常数，不是已校准散射长度或随 Q 变化的 X: bA/bB are signed relative constants, not calibrated lengths/Q-dependent X-ray factors. Kinematic cross-section constants/Debye–Waller omitted.
translations.无限一维谐链存在长波涨落问题；本页只演示有限 Q/能量窗口及显式低能截断下的一声: An infinite one-dimensional harmonic chain has long-wavelength fluctuation issues. This page demonstrates one-phonon kinematics in finite Q/energy windows with an explicit low-energy cutoff, not the complete finite-temperature structure factor of an infinite chain.
translations.所有能量低于 ZXQD0DQXZ meV 的模均从非弹性谱排除，尤其 q=0 的: All modes below ZXQD0DQXZ meV are excluded from inelastic spectra, especially the q=0 rigid acoustic mode. Broadening does not turn the 1/ω singularity into an elastic peak. Elastic, multiphonon, and quasielastic contributions are absent.
translations.Gaussian 的 σ 是能量标准差，FWHM=2√(2ln2)σ。Stoke: Gaussian σ is energy standard deviation, FWHM=2√(2ln2)σ. Stokes positive(probe→lattice energy), anti-Stokes negative. Detailed balance checks unbroadened weights, not broadened pointwise curves.
translations.本页没有导入 Phonopy 数据。现有导入器可用于检查结构与单模；完整散射还需: This page does not import Phonopy data. The existing importer can inspect structures and individual modes; full scattering also needs explicit Å units, primitive cells, masses, complete complex eigenvectors at matching q points and scattering weights, which frequencies or a single-mode animation cannot supply.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 范围内的: ZXQD0DQXZ must be finite numeric within ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
translations.channel 仅支持 both、stokes、antiStokes: channel supports only both, stokes or antiStokes
translations.Q 与能量扫描终点必须大于起点: Q and energy scan endpoints must exceed starting points
translations.动力学矩阵出现非物理负本征值: dynamical matrix  has unphysical negative eigenvalues
translations.meV 的模均从非弹性谱排除，尤其 q=0 的刚体声学模。没有用展宽把 1/ω: meV are excluded from inelastic spectra, especially the q=0 rigid acoustic mode. Broadening does not turn the 1/ω singularity into an elastic peak. Elastic, multiphonon, and quasielastic contributions are absent.
translations.能量采样步长大于 σ/2，细峰形可能欠采样；请增加采样点、缩小能量窗口或增大展宽: Energy step>σ/2 may undersample peaks; increase points, narrow window, or broaden.
translations.当前选定 Q 的能量窗口未覆盖至少95%的总谱权重；完整权重和窗口积分已分别列出: The selected Q energy window covers less than 95% of total spectral weight; full weights and window integrals are listed separately.
translations.热图的 ZXQD0DQXZ 个 Q 点共有 ZXQD1DQXZ 个模因低能截断被: Across ZXQD0DQXZ heatmap Q points, ZXQD1DQXZ modes are excluded by the low-energy cutoff. Brightness near reciprocal points depends on this cutoff; keep it fixed for comparisons.
translations.当前 Q 有简并模；强度按完整简并子空间求和。导出的各个本征矢可任意酉混合，单独: Current Q has degeneracies; sum full subspace intensities. Exported vectors permit arbitrary unitary mixing; individual branch labels are nonunique.
translations.选定 Q 不在热图扫描范围内；其独立能谱仍使用相同模型计算。: Selected Q lies outside the heatmap scan; its independent spectrum still uses the same model.
translations.个模因低能截断被排除；近倒格点亮度依赖此截断，比较时须保持它相同。: modes excluded by the low-energy cutoff; brightness near reciprocal points depends on this cutoff, so keep it fixed in comparisons.
translations.选定 Q 的模与散射权重: Modes and scattering weights at selected Q
translations.低于一声子能量截断；未计算弹性或准弹性散射: Below the one-phonon energy cutoff; elastic/quasielastic scattering is not calculated
translations.导入数据只有一个网格；请外部提供更密完整 BZ 数据进行比较。: Imported data have one mesh only; supply a denser full-BZ dataset externally for comparison.
translations.常数、标量且与能量无关的弛豫时间 τ 近似；忽略电子相互作用修正、带间相干、Ha: Constant scalar energy-independent  relaxation time  τ approximation; no interaction corrections, interband coherence, Hall/Berry, or magnetic-field response.
translations.S 的约定为开路 E=S∇T，电子电荷为 −e。κ_e 已扣除开路热电回流项；不: S uses open-circuit E=S∇T with electron charge −e. κ_e subtracts the open-circuit thermoelectric backflow term; it is not bare L₂/T.
translations.填充/电子密度仅统计所给能带；holeDensity 是同一有限能带集合中的空态: Filling/electron density counts only supplied bands; holeDensity counts empty states within that finite set, not automatically real doping density.
translations.仅计算电子贡献，不含声子热导、实际散射寿命或真实材料 ZT；给定 τ 才输出 σ: Electronic contribution only, no  phonon  thermal conductivity, actual lifetimes, or material ZT;σ/κ_e need specified τ.
translations.网格积分必须解析 kBT 热窗口。化学势扫描可在低温稀疏网格上产生伪峰，请检查有: Mesh integration must resolve the kBT thermal window. Chemical-potential scans may show spurious peaks on sparse low-temperature meshes; check effective sampled states and mesh comparisons.

translations.输入能量绝对值须≤1000 eV，速度分量绝对值须≤10⁸ m/s: Energy magnitudes must be ≤1000 eV and velocity-component magnitudes ≤10⁸ m/s
translations.费米热窗口内的权重过小，载流子极少或能带接近全满；S 与 κ 的比值/抵消计算不: Fermi-window weight is too small: carriers are scarce or bands nearly full. S and κ ratios/cancellations are unreliable and return null.
translations.热窗口的有效输运采样态少于 12；请提高网格密度并比较收敛，不能把离散峰解释为材: Fewer than12 effective  transport  thermal-window states; refine/compare convergence, do not interpret discrete peaks as material features.

translations.输运 JSON 输入上限 4 MB: Transport JSON input limit is 4 MB
translations.muMin 必须小于 muMax: muMin must be less than muMax
translations.网格×能带×化学势点超过 1500 万，请减少扫描点或网格: Mesh×bands×chemical-potential points exceeds 15 million; reduce scan points or mesh
translations.只对当前 μ、T 比较两网格；不是全扫描的收敛证明。达到上限时与较粗网格比较。: Compare grids only at current μ, T, not full scans. At limits compare coarser grids.
translations.二维结果为片电导/片电子热导，不把真空层厚度当物理体积；转换三维单位必须另给有物: Two-dimensional results are sheet electrical/electronic thermal conductances, without treating vacuum thickness as physical volume; conversion to 3D units needs a physically meaningful thickness.
translations.已验证规则网格覆盖与权重，但不能独立验证用户提供的能量、速度和能带窗口是否收敛或: Regular coverage/weights are verified, but supplied energies, velocities, and band windows cannot be independently confirmed converged or from one physical model.
translations.输运矩阵奇异或严重病态，部分方向没有可解析的导电响应；完整 S、κ 张量返回 n: The transport matrix is singular/severely ill-conditioned, with unresolved conduction directions. Full S and κ return null.
translations.电子热导协方差出现显著负特征值；数值不可靠，κ 返回 null。: Thermal covariance has significantly negative eigenvalues; unreliable numerics,κ=null.
translations.输入须为有限 JSON 数据: Input must be finite JSON data
translations.当前 μ、T 的两网格结果差异较大或无法比较；数值只作未收敛演示，不作为定量材料: The two meshes differ substantially or cannot be compared at current μ,T. Values are unconverged demonstrations, not quantitative material predictions.
translations.确定周期模型与速度: Define the periodic model and velocities
translations.完整 BZ 权重和为 1；自旋简并只乘一次。速度必须是笛卡尔 m/s，路径本征值: Full BZ weights sum1, spin degeneracy counts once. Cartesian m/s required, path eigenvalues cannot complete integrals.
translations.对费米热窗口积分: Integrate over the thermal Fermi window
translations.E、μ 在积分中换为 J；Ω 是三维体积或二维面积。数值采用 x=(E−μ)/(: E,μ convert to J inside integration; Ω is 3D volume or 2D area. x=(E−μ)/(kBT) avoids ill-conditioned energy moments.
translations.电子热导扣除电流被开路条件抵消的贡献。常数 τ 在 S 中抵消；σ 和 κ 与: Electronic thermal conductivity subtracts the contribution canceled by the open-circuit current condition. Constant τ cancels from S; σ and κ scale with τ.
translations.有效载流子太少或导电矩阵奇异时不输出不稳定 S、κ；两网格比较只约束当前 μ、T: Few carriers/singular conductivity suppress unstable S,κ; two-mesh checks constrain current μ, T only.
translations.输入须为参数对象。: Input must be a parameter object.
translations.垂直键的yz镜面: yz mirror perpendicular to the bond
translations.单位长度经典向量的一个全局极小值代表；奇异值简并时不唯一，不是量子基态磁矩。: One global-minimum representative for unit-length classical vectors; nonunique for degenerate singular values and not a quantum ground-state moment.
translations.绕键轴的ZXQD0DQXZ重旋转: ZXQD0DQXZ-fold rotation about the bond axis
translations.单条有向键i→j沿x；使用真实轴向自旋和端点交换，不以一般体张量替代键约束。所有: One directed bond i→j along x, using axial spins and endpoint exchange rather than general bulk tensors. Coefficients are teaching inputs; projection uses matrix Frobenius norm. Allowed terms may vanish and no material magnitude is predicted.
translations.量子模型为两个可区分的自旋1/2，S=σ/2、能量meV。经典箭头为单位向量的一: Two distinguishable spins1/2, S=σ/2, energies meV. Classical unit arrows represent global minima; singular-value degeneracy gives multiple representatives, not finite-quantum-ground-state moments.
translations.能谱具有双自旋时间反演T²=+1，不能凭时间反演宣称Kramers配对。能级简并: The spectrum has two-spin time reversal T²=+1, which does not justify Kramers pairing. Degeneracies reflect these parameters and do not establish survival under every allowed perturbation.
translations.坐标对照采用被动正交旋转v′=Q^T v；交换端点使J→J^T、D→−D。D分量: Coordinate comparison uses passive orthogonal v′=Q^T v; endpoint exchange gives J→J^T,D→−D. Changed D components need not mean changed physics. No lattice magnetic order, magnon dispersion, or material weak-ferromagnetic moments are calculated.
translations.被动转轴v′=Q^T v；若交换i/j，先J→J^T再转轴。: Passive axes v′=Q^T v; if i/j exchange, first J→J^T, then rotate axes.
translations.键轴旋转只能为无、二重或四重。: Bond-axis rotation must be none, twofold or fourfold.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 超出教学范围。: ZXQD0DQXZ is outside the teaching-model range.
translations.一个经典极小代表的夹角；简并处代表可改变: Angle of one classical minimum representative; it can change at degeneracy
translations.限制在xy面且固定第一个自旋沿x的试探能量: Trial energy constrained to xy with the first spin fixed along x
translations.输入、约束后与约定变换后的交换张量: Input, constrained and convention-transformed exchange tensors
translations.操作保持端点时J=A^TJA；交换端点时J=A^TJ^TA，其中A=det(R): Fixed endpoints require J=A^TJA; exchanged endpoints require J=A^TJ^TA, with A=det(R)R.
translations.约定Jxy−Jyx=2Dz；交换有向键同时交换自旋次序与D符号。: The convention is Jxy−Jyx=2Dz; reversing a directed bond reverses both spin ordering and the sign of D.
translations.经典双自旋的全局下界: Global lower bound for two classical spins
translations.对单位向量，双线性型最小值由最大奇异值给出；受限xy平面的试探曲线不一定达到该全: The largest singular value gives the unit-vector bilinear minimum; restricted xy trials need not reach it.
translations.选定生成元及所声明平移生成的子群；不枚举整个结构的对称群: Subgroup generated by selected generators and declared translations; the full structural group is not enumerated
translations.主动操作，右边先作用；坐标和箭头均使用正交笛卡尔坐标。精确数保留为有理数或 sq: Active operations, rightmost first; coordinates/arrows use orthogonal  Cartesian coordinates . Exact rationals/sqrt(3) retained.
translations.空间与内部变换同时作用: Spatial and internal transformations act together
translations.无（显示选定有限子群本身）: None (show the selected finite subgroup itself)
translations.联合生成元生成的有限子群: Finite subgroup generated by combined generators
translations.图中是三维周期结构的一个晶胞及其像；沿 x、y、z 均可作任意整数平移。完整空间: The plot shows one cell of a 3D periodic structure and its image. Arbitrary integer translations exist along x,y,z. The full space group is infinite; tables show the finite quotient modulo integer translations.
translations.八阶双点群 Q8 本身: The order-eight double point group Q8 itself
translations.Q₈：双点群 222；模 {E,barE} 得 D₂: Q₈: double point group 222; quotient by {E,barE} gives D₂
translations.X=−iσx，Y=−iσy，Z=−iσz。逐步动画交替先 X、再 Y；累计矩阵为: X=−iσx, Y=−iσy, Z=−iσz. The animation alternates X then Y, multiplying each new operation on the left; four steps give barE and eight give E.

translations.每个二重旋转提升的平方为 barE: Every lifted twofold rotation squares to barE
translations.SU(2) 负号投影到相同的 SO(3) 旋转: The SU(2) minus sign projects to the same SO(3) rotation
translations.采用右手主动旋转约定；X、Y、Z 分别沿 x、y、z 轴。: Use right-handed active rotations; X, Y and Z act about x, y and z, respectively.
translations.2π 旋转在经典箭头上不可见，在旋量上是 −I；只有相对参考路径才能观测整体负号: 2π is invisible to classical arrows but gives spinor−I; only a reference path makes the overall sign observable.
translations.螺旋先累积平移再检查是否回到单位元，不能仅凭折回晶胞后的坐标判定。: Accumulate screw translations before testing identity; wrapped coordinates alone are insufficient.
translations.这里只对适当旋转作 SU(2) 提升；镜面与反演的双群约定需另行指定，不能仅把任: Only proper rotations receive SU(2) lifts here. Double-group conventions for mirrors and inversion require separate specification; arbitrary 3×3 matrices cannot simply become spinor matrices.
translations.双群的中心负号、颜色置换和独立自旋空间旋转是不同的扩充。图中箭头是旋量的 Blo: The double-group central sign, color permutations, and independent spin-space rotations are different extensions. Arrows show spinor Bloch vectors, not overall phases.

translations.三色空间群：分数平移与颜色循环: Three-color space group: fractional translations and color cycles
translations.自旋点群：独立的两个旋转轴: Spin point group: two independent rotation axes
translations.自旋点群：120° 共面三角结构: Spin point group: a coplanar 120° triangle
translations.自旋空间群：三层共面螺旋结构: Spin space group: three-layer coplanar helix
translations.组合生成元保持每个格点的颜色或磁矩: Combined  generator  preserves each site's color/moment

translations.负对照：仅内部变换不保持图样: Negative control: internal-only action fails to preserve the pattern

translations.这是选定生成操作产生的有限子群，不声称列出该图样的全部对称性。: This is the finite subgroup of selected generators, not every symmetry of the pattern.
translations.颜色编号为抽象离散标签，允许的置换必须与空间操作成群；本实验选用 3 循环，未枚: Color indices are abstract discrete labels, and allowed permutations must form a group with spatial operations. This experiment uses a three-cycle, not an enumeration of arbitrary n-color groups.
translations.黑白交换本身是二元置换。只有赋予时间反演的物理作用后才是磁群操作；量子时间反演需: Black-and-white exchange is a two-element permutation. Only an assigned physical time-reversal action makes it magnetic; quantum time reversal requires conjugation and is not color exchange.

translations.本例 C3 生成子群内仅 E 保持所有颜色: Only E preserves every color within this example’s generated C3 subgroup
translations.忘去平移后，联合自旋平移仍投影为非平凡 [U∥I]；核是自旋也恒等的纯平移，不能: After forgetting translation, combined spin translations still project to nontrivial [U∥I]. The kernel is pure translations with identity spin action; not every [U∥I|t] can be factored out.
translations.这里 U 是经典磁矩的适当旋转，全部 det(U)=+1，表示幺正自旋旋转。一般: U is a proper classical-moment rotation, all det(U)=+1, representing unitary spin rotations. General  spin group  can contain det(U)=−1 actions, usually quantum  time reversal , not this finite example's ordinary SU(2) matrices.
translations.在弱 SOC 或忽略 SOC 的近似中，自旋与晶格旋转可独立。启用 SOC 时普: For weak or neglected SOC, spin and lattice rotations can be independent. With SOC, ordinary unitary spatial symmetries lock moment transformations to det(R)R; magnetic operations may additionally include time reversal.
translations.SOC 锁定测试只检查该空间操作配合指定的普通幺正自旋变换。未通过不排除另一个反: The SOC-locking test checks the given spatial operation with the specified ordinary unitary spin action only. Failure does not exclude another antiunitary magnetic operation preserving the same collinear order, such as time reversal plus half translation.
translations.自旋群 [U∥R|t] 与 Spin(3)=SU(2) 的双覆盖不是同一概念。对: spin group  [U∥R|t] differs from Spin(3)=SU(2) double covers. Lifting this example's SO(3) spin factors produces extra2π central signs.
translations.有限表格仅涵盖选定生成元。共线结构还具有保持自旋方向的 SO(2) 连续自旋独立: The finite table covers selected generators only. Collinear structures additionally have a continuous independent SO(2) spin subgroup preserving the spin direction; the entire spin group is not finite C2.
translations.将内部旋转换成由空间操作锁定的轴向变换后，本例保持图样：ZXQD0DQXZ这只检: After replacing the internal rotation by the axial-vector transformation locked to the spatial operation, this example preserves the pattern: ZXQD0DQXZ. This checks only that operation; it does not calculate the material's actual SOC strength.

translations.两带在解析动量处接触；本实现要求孤立带，停止报告带分辨横向响应。热图仅显示未简并: Bands touch at analytic momenta. Isolated bands are required, so band-resolved transverse responses are withheld. The heatmap shows nondegenerate sampled points only, not full transport of the gapless system.
translations.二维 QWZ 两带模型，采用固定周期轨道基底；不含真实材料拟合、自旋简并倍数、普: 2D QWZ in fixed periodic orbitals, no material fit, spin doubling, ordinary-field Hall, side jumps, or skew scattering.
translations.σxy 是片电导（S），αxy 是片横向热电响应（A/K）；不指定厚度转换成三维: σxy is sheet conductance (S) and αxy sheet transverse thermoelectric response (A/K); no thickness is assumed for conversion to 3D units. Electron charge is −e, and jx=σxy Ey−αxy∂yT.
translations.αxy 不是开路 Nernst 电压或 Seebeck 系数。开路信号需要同一模: αxy is neither open-circuit Nernst voltage nor Seebeck coefficient. Those require full σ,α tensors of the same model/units through S=σ⁻¹α. Unrelated longitudinal tensors are not combined here.
translations.温度与化学势独立指定；没有固定掺杂的电中性求解。两条带的贡献一并积分，满带/空带: Independent T,μ, no fixed-doping neutrality. Both bands integrate; full/empty states carry no Fermi entropy.
translations.每个 μ 扫描点均做两层网格比较；稳定是有限容差诊断，不是严格误差界。低温金属费: Every μ-scan point compares two mesh levels; stability is a finite-tolerance diagnostic rather than a rigorous error bound. Low-temperature metallic Fermi surfaces and near-critical curvature hotspots may require meshes far beyond this page’s limits.
translations.真实 Wannier Berry 响应一般还需位置/连接矩阵及轨道嵌入约定，不能: Actual Wannier Berry responses generally also need position/connection matrices and embedding conventions; an hr file alone is not a full first-principles response.
translations.化学势扫描终点必须大于起点: Chemical-potential scan end must exceed start
translations.当前 μ、T 的两层网格与下带曲率积分检查通过；这不是所有温度和参数的收敛证明。: The two-mesh comparison and lower-band curvature integral pass at current μ,T; this does not prove convergence for all temperatures and parameters.
translations.当前网格未能同时通过下带曲率积分和响应加密比较；数值仅为待收敛估计，请提高网格或: The mesh fails the combined lower-band curvature integral and response-refinement checks. Values remain estimates; increase mesh or temperature and check critical parameters.
translations.T=0 的 αxy 取严格极限0；金属的阶跃占据用离散网格积分，不提供由阶跃曲线: At T=0,αxy=0 strictly; metal steps integrate on discrete grids, no Mott prediction from coarse differentiation.
translations.固定模型、基底与符号: Fix the model, basis and signs
translations.s 以 eV 输入，k 为无量纲 ka。正的共同能量尺度不改变曲率。: s is entered in eV; k is dimensionless ka. A positive common energy scale leaves curvature unchanged.
translations.网格平均必须覆盖完整二维布里渊区，不能使用高对称线代替。: Mesh averaging must cover the full two-dimensional Brillouin zone, not a high-symmetry line.
translations.这是扣除平衡磁化电流后的内禀输运热电系数。严格零温熵核为零。: Intrinsic  transport   thermoelectric  after equilibrium-magnetization subtraction; strict zero-T entropy kernel vanishes.

translations.本页只给出内禀横向项，不把 αxy 除以任意数值冒充 Nernst 信号。: Only intrinsic transverse terms are supplied. Dividing αxy by an arbitrary number does not create a Nernst signal.
translations.仅计算 2–4 站点、单轨道、零温、无自旋翻转场的 Hubbard 模型；t、U: Only2–4-site, single-orbital, zero-T, no-spin-flip-field Hubbard; t, U,Δ specified, no material fitting/crystal solution.
translations.所有主谱和局域量固定 N↑、N↓，按 10⁻⁹ eV 容差将基态数值简并空间等权: All main spectra and local quantities fix N↑,N↓ and equally average numerical ground degeneracies within 10⁻⁹ eV. Actual splittings below tolerance are unresolved; fixed-Sz mixtures are not rotationally invariant thermal averages across a whole spin multiplet.
translations.“扇区激发隙”是离开所选简并基态子空间后的下一不同能级，不等于普适自旋隙。总 N: A sector excitation gap reaches the next distinct energy outside its selected degenerate ground space; it is not a universal spin gap. Total-N ground energies and charge gaps separately minimize over all allowed Sz sectors.
translations.2–4 站点的有限能级间距或电荷增减隙不能证明热力学 Mott 相变；有限尺寸、: Finite2–4-site spacings/charge gaps do not establish thermodynamic Mott transitions; size, boundary, filling, staggering also gap.
translations.周期边界使用每对站点之间的一条无向键，N=2 与开放二聚体相同；N=3 为三角环: Periodic boundaries use one undirected bond per site pair: N=2 is the open dimer, N=3 a triangle and N=4 a four-site ring.
translations.εᵢ=(−1)^i Δ/2，0号站点取正号。三站点时不减去平均在位能，周期奇数环: εᵢ=(−1)^i Δ/2, with positive sign on site 0. For three sites the mean onsite energy is not removed, and an odd periodic ring cannot alternate perfectly at closure.
translations.自旋点积包括横向翻转项；只计算 SzSz 会漏掉单重态的量子关联。双占据是无量纲: Spin dot products include transverse flips; SzSz misses singlet correlations. Double occupancy is dimensionless, not charge-density units.
translations.U 扫描固定 t、Δ、边界和 N↑、N↓；有限采样线段只用于阅读，简并或扇区变化: U scans fix t, Δ, boundaries and N↑,N↓; finite-sample line segments guide reading only. Connections across degeneracy/sector changes do not continuously track one eigenstate.

translations.当前固定自旋扇区的最低能量高于同总 N 的全局基态；不能将当前局域量当成无自旋约: The selected spin sector lies above the global ground state at the same N. Its local observables are not spin-unconstrained ground-state results.
translations.t=0 为原子极限；多个占据组态可简并，结果是该扇区简并态等权，不能据此声称自发: t=0 is atomic; configurations may degenerate. Equal-sector averages do not establish spontaneous magnetic order.

translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 必须为 [ZXQD1DQXZ, ZXQD2DQXZ] 内的整: ZXQD0DQXZ must be an integer in [ZXQD1DQXZ, ZXQD2DQXZ]

translations.利用 (Ωσₓ+Δσ_z)²=(Ω²+Δ²)I，令 Ω_eff=√(Ω²+Δ²): Use (Ωσₓ+Δσ_z)²=(Ω²+Δ²)I and Ω_eff=√(Ω²+Δ²), splitting exponential powers into odd and even terms.
translations.得到 U(t)=cos(Ω_eff t/2)I−i sin(Ω_eff t/2): Obtain U(t)=cos(Ω_eff t/2)I−i sin(Ω_eff t/2)(Ωσₓ+Δσ_z)/Ω_eff; continue to I at zero field.
translations.取 |↓⟩ 分量的模平方：P↓=Ω²/(Ω²+Δ²) sin²(Ω_eff t/: Take the squared modulus of the |↓⟩ component: P↓=Ω²/(Ω²+Δ²) sin²(Ω_eff t/2)=ZXQD0DQXZ.
translations.共振 Δ=0 且 Ω>0 时，t=π/Ω 为 π 脉冲；失谐会使振荡幅度低于 1: On resonance Δ=0,Ω>0, t=π/Ω is a π pulse. Detuning reduces oscillation amplitude below 1.
translations.这是恒定有效哈密顿量的解析演化。若来自受驱二能级系统，需在适用条件下选旋转坐标系: Analytic evolution with constant effective H. For driven two-level systems, use an applicable rotating frame/RWA;  decoherence  is excluded.
translations.Bloch 球表示态的期望值，不直接显示整体相位。概率周期与态矢量恢复周期一般不: The Bloch sphere shows state expectations rather than global phases. Probability periods generally differ from state-vector return periods.
translations.Ω=0 时初态只有相位演化、布居恒定，概率周期留空；数值范围无法表示的极长周期也: At Ω=0 the initial state changes only phase, with constant populations; probability period is blank. Unrepresentably long periods are also blank.
translations.参数范围：0≤Ω≤10，−10≤Δ≤10，0≤t≤20；这里输入角频率，不把数值: Ranges: 0≤Ω≤10, −10≤Δ≤10, 0≤t≤20; inputs are angular frequencies, not Hz.
translations.两个表示的维数为 ZXQD0DQXZ 与 ZXQD1DQXZ，故直积空间有 ZX: The representation dimensions are ZXQD0DQXZ and ZXQD1DQXZ, so the product space has dimension ZXQD2DQXZ.

translations.选定乘积态有 M=m₁+m₂=ZXQD0DQXZ，只需保留 J≥|M| 的总角动: Selected product state has M=m₁+m₂=ZXQD0DQXZ; retain only total angular momenta J≥|M|.
translations.用 Condon–Shortley 相位约定计算 C(j₁m₁,j₂m₂|JM): Condon–Shortley  phase convention  calculates C(j₁m₁,j₂m₂|JM). These real coefficients expand product states in |JM⟩; J probabilities are squares.
translations.由 J²=S₁²+S₂²+2S₁·S₂，H=κS₁·S₂ 的能量为 E_J=κ[: From J²=S₁²+S₂²+2S₁·S₂, H=κS₁·S₂ has energy E_J=κ[J(J+1)−j₁(j₁+1)−j₂(j₂+1)]/2.
translations.采用 ℏ=1，S₁、S₂ 为无量纲角动量，κ 给出能量单位。κ>0 的两自旋 1: Use ℏ=1 and dimensionless S₁,S₂; κ supplies energy units. For κ>0, two spin-1/2 objects have a lowest singlet.
translations.固定相位约定使两自旋 1/2 的单重态为 (|↑↓⟩−|↓↑⟩)/√2；改变整条: Fixed  phase convention  gives spin-1/2 singlet (|↑↓⟩−|↓↑⟩)/√2; rephasing the whole  multiplet  leaves probabilities.
translations.输入 j₁、j₂ 支持 0,1/2,…,3；输出全部总角动量多重态，并验证完整耦: Inputs j₁,j₂ support 0,1/2,…,3; output includes all total-angular-momentum multiplets and verifies orthogonality of the complete coupled basis and J² eigenrelations.

translations.用最高权 Dynkin 标签 (p,q) 指定不可约表示：d=(p+1)(q+1: Specify irreps by highest-weight Dynkin labels (p,q): d=(p+1)(q+1)(p+q+2)/2. Equal dimensions need not imply equivalent representations.
translations.枚举顶行 (p+q,q,0) 的 Gelfand–Tsetlin 整数交错图；相: Enumerate Gelfand–Tsetlin integer interlacing patterns with top row (p+q,q,0). Adjacent row-sum differences give three content numbers, whose differences give Dynkin weights (a,b).
translations.直积中两因子的权逐对相加，重数相乘并累加；同一个权位置可代表多个线性无关态。: Add factor weights pairwise, multiply/accumulate  multiplicity ; one weight position can represent independent states.
translations.从剩余字符选取占优最高权，减去相应完整不可约权字符。循环至所有权重数为零，即得到: Select a dominant highest weight from the remaining character and subtract its complete irreducible weight character. Repeat until all weight multiplicities vanish, obtaining a direct sum including repeated irreps.
translations.把每项的维数乘以外重数后相加，并用独立的 Weyl 行列式字符公式检查结果；C₂: Sum each dimension times outer multiplicity and independently check Weyl determinant characters; C₂(p,q)=(p²+q²+pq+3p+3q)/3.
translations.坐标采用 T₃=λ₃/2、T₈=λ₈/2：权 (a,b) 显示为 (a/2,(a: Use T₃=λ₃/2, T₈=λ₈/2 coordinates;(a, b) plots at (a/2,(a+2b)/(2√3)).  weight diagram  is not real space.
translations.这里输出不可约表示与外重数，以及每个权空间的内重数；不输出 SU(3) Cleb: Output includes irreps, outer multiplicities and internal multiplicity of each weight space, but not SU(3) Clebsch–Gordan basis-change coefficients.
translations.每个因子支持非负整数 p,q 且 p+q≤4（最大 27 维），总维数至多 72: Each factor requires nonnegative integer p,q with p+q≤4 (maximum dimension 27), total dimension ≤729. Output highest weights may exceed input limits.

translations.T₈ 的本征值为 (1,1,−2)/(2√3)，因此此单参矩阵的最小正周期为 4: T₈ eigenvalues (1,1,−2)/(2√3) give least positive period 4π√3; at θ=4π√3/3 it is nontrivial center exp(−2πi/3)I₃.

translations.此单参矩阵的最小正周期为 4π；2π 时 U=−I₂，Bloch 向量已复原而旋: Least positive period4π; at2π, U=−I₂, the Bloch vector returns but spinor changes sign.
translations.T₁…T₇ 的本征值为 1/2、−1/2、0，此单参矩阵的最小正周期为 4π；2: T₁…T₇ have eigenvalues 1/2,−1/2,0, giving these one-parameter matrices a smallest positive period 4π; 2π is generally not an SU(3) central element.
translations.Bloch 向量按所选轴右手主动旋转；2π 后 Bloch 向量相同，但 U 与: The Bloch vector rotates actively by the right-hand rule. At 2π it returns, but U and −U are distinct SU(2) elements.
translations.三个权重点是基本表示中共同本征态的 (T₃,T₈) 本征值；一般叠加态的期望点不: Three weight points are simultaneous fundamental (T₃,T₈) eigenvalues; superposition expectation points are not new weights. SU(3) need not be spatial angles.

translations.使用基本表示和选定的单个生成元；不把一个滑块当作整个多参数李群。: Uses the fundamental representation and one selected generator; a single slider is not the entire multiparameter Lie group.
translations.列向量按 |ψ′⟩=U|ψ⟩ 变换；概率为各复振幅的模平方。整体相位不改变此基下: Columns transform by |ψ′⟩=U|ψ⟩; probabilities square complex magnitudes. Global phase leaves these probabilities.
translations.数值残差由未清零的内部复数计算；矩阵显示中小于 10⁻¹⁴ 的实部或虚部显示为: Numerical residuals use internal complex values without zeroing; displayed real/imaginary matrix components below 10⁻¹⁴ appear as 0.
translations.按 [Tₐ,Tᵦ]=TₐTᵦ−TᵦTₐ 计算，右端写作 i∑cₖTₖ；交换 a、: Using [Tₐ,Tᵦ]=TₐTᵦ−TᵦTₐ, right side i∑cₖTₖ; exchanging a, b reverses coefficient.
translations.由 tr(TₖTₗ)=δₖₗ/2 得 cₖ=−2i tr([Tₐ,Tᵦ]Tₖ)。: From tr(TₖTₗ)=δₖₗ/2, cₖ=−2i tr([Tₐ,Tᵦ]Tₖ). Nonzero coefficients are structure constants under this convention.
translations.厄米生成元的对易子是反厄米矩阵；−i[Tₐ,Tᵦ] 才是厄米生成元的实线性组合。: A commutator of Hermitian generators is anti-Hermitian; −i[Tₐ,Tᵦ] is a real linear combination of Hermitian generators.
translations.本实验检查选定生成元的李代数闭合关系；并非任意有限转动交换子的数值模拟。: Check selected  generator   Lie algebra  closure, not arbitrary finite-rotation commutator simulations.

translations.coordination 必须为 octahedral 或 tetrahedra: coordination must be octahedral or tetrahedral
translations.这是固定电子数、孤立五 d 轨道的 Kanamori 教学模型，包含自旋翻转与成: An isolated five-d-orbital Kanamori teaching model at fixed electron count, including spin flips and pair hopping, without SOC, fields, ligands, bandwidth, temperature, or charge transfer.
translations.U′=U−2J；不同轨道同自旋排斥为 U−3J。五轨道统一 J 的 Kanamo: U′=U−2J; different-orbital same-spin repulsion U−3J. Common-J Kanamori is not full F⁰/F²/F⁴ Slater; no real LS terms, NiO excitations, XAS/RIXS.
translations.无 SOC 且相互作用保持自旋 SU(2)，因此可用严格 S 分类；能量相同但: There is no SOC, and interactions preserve spin SU(2), so exact S classifies states. Equal-energy spaces with different S are displayed separately; occupancies average all degenerate states with the same energy and S.
translations.固定 N 时 U 只贡献共同偏移 U·N(N−1)/2；改变 U 不改变此模型的: At fixed N, U contributes only U·N(N−1)/2, leaving level differences, spin, and occupations unchanged. Energies at different N are not direct real-material charge-transition energies.
translations.扫描只显示有限采样点，未自动寻找全部交叉点；自旋切换处须局部加密。基态偶然包含多: Finite scans do not locate all crossings; refine spin switches. Report all accidentally degenerate S; mean S² is not a pure-state quantum number.
translations.配位与 Δ 为现象学输入；没有从真实结构拟合。NiO 仅为 d⁸ 局域配位的材料: Coordination and Δ are phenomenological inputs, not fits to a real structure. NiO provides local d⁸ coordination background only; every preset uses teaching parameters.
translations.不支持的参数：ZXQD0DQXZ；本模块没有 SOC 或任意库仑矩阵接口: Unsupported parameters: ZXQD0DQXZ. This module provides neither SOC nor an arbitrary Coulomb-matrix interface
translations.本教学范围要求 U≥3J≥0，使平行自旋的不同轨道密度排斥非负: Teaching range requires U≥3J≥0, ensuring nonnegative interorbital parallel-spin density repulsion
translations.所选联合能量/自旋组超出范围：本次结果只有 ZXQD0DQXZ 组，序号从0开始: Selected joint energy/spin group is out of range: only ZXQD0DQXZ groups, zero-based

translations.十个自旋轨道按费米反对易规则生成行列式；再按 N↑、N↓ 分块。: Ten spin orbitals generate determinants by fermion anticommutation, then split into N↑,N↓ blocks.
translations.同轨道 U、异轨道异自旋 U−2J、同自旋 U−3J，以及 −J S⁺_m S⁻: Same-orbital U, interorbital opposite-spin U−2J and same-spin U−3J, plus −J S⁺_m S⁻_n and +J P†_m P_n for all ordered orbital pairs.
translations.先对角化每个 Sz 块，再在同能子空间对角化 S²。联合子空间的占据迹平均不依赖: Diagonalize Sz blocks, then S² within degenerate energies. Occupation trace averages are basis independent.
translations.Δ/J 与 N 决定当前模型的自旋竞争；ΔU 仅增加 ΔU·N(N−1)/2: Δ/J and N determine spin competition; ΔU adds only ΔU·N(N−1)/2
translations.扫描 Δ 时保持 N、U、J 和配位固定，查看基态 S、轨道占据和到下一不同能量: Scan Δ at fixed N, U, J, coordination; inspect ground S, occupations, next distinct-energy gap.
translations.一个小角线性本征模；纵向分量仅为保持箭头长度而重归一化，不是完整非线性动力学。: A linear small-angle mode; longitudinal components are renormalized only to maintain arrow length, not full nonlinear dynamics.
translations.无阻尼线性频率为实数；Δ=1 的 q=0 矩阵含零频 Jordan 块，实频率不: Undamped linear frequencies are real; at Δ=1, q=0 the matrix contains a zero-frequency Jordan block, so real frequencies do not imply bounded perturbations. Negative-energy modes are not stable ground-state excitations.
translations.本最近邻 XXZ 经典链中 |h|≤h_sf=2JS√(Δ²−1)；在阈值处两相: For this nearest-neighbor classical XXZ chain, |h|≤h_sf=2JS√(Δ²−1). At threshold two phases are degenerate; above it Néel is not the ground state. This is not an exact finite-S quantum-chain critical field.
translations.S⁺_n(t)=Sρ c_s exp[i(qa n−λt/ℏ)]；ρ 是最大横向: S⁺_n(t)=Sρ c_s exp[i(qa n−λt/ℏ)];ρ=max transverse amplitude/S.

translations.无阻尼线性方程频率为实数；负能模式仍表示参考态能量不稳定。: Undamped linear frequencies are real; negative-energy modes still mean energetic instability.
translations.+z 参考态局部能量稳定要求 h+2JS(Δ−1)≥0；全局经典基态要求 h≥0: Local energetic stability of the +z reference requires h+2JS(Δ−1)≥0; a global classical ground state requires h≥0.
translations.参考态含负能模式，关闭稳定进动演示；请降低外场或改用稳定参考态。: The reference has negative-energy modes; stable-precession animation is disabled. Lower the field or choose a stable reference.

translations.仅计算2–4站点单带Hubbard模型的零温有限团簇；不给出真实材料绝对光电子截: Zero-temperature finite-cluster calculations only, for 2–4-site single-band Hubbard models; no absolute photoemission cross sections, thermodynamic Mott diagrams, or self-consistent finite-T results.

translations.两站点周期边界只有一条无向键；三站点周期边界是三角环。电子轨道排序为全部上自旋、: Two-site periodic chains have one undirected bond; three-site ones are triangles. Order all ↑ then all ↓; retain Fermi signs.

translations.给定配对势的平均场教学模型；没有自洽能隙方程，不预测临界温度、配对机制或具体材料: Mean-field teaching model with a specified pairing potential; no self-consistent gap equation or predictions of transition temperature, pairing mechanisms or material parameters.

translations.Kitaev 链是有效无自旋奇宇称模型，不是带自旋电子的单态 s 波链；Δij=: Kitaev is effective spinless odd parity, not spinful singlet s wave; Δij=−Δji ensures Fermi antisymmetry.

translations.给定配对势，不求自洽能隙，也不预测真实材料的临界温度、输运电导或 Majoran: Specified pairing, no self-consistent gaps or real Tc,  transport  conductance, Majorana predictions.

translations.正g使被电子占据的振子向负X偏移；ε_0=+Δ/2、ε_1=−Δ/2。输入g是局: Positive g shifts occupied oscillators to negative X; ε_0=+Δ/2, ε_1=−Δ/2. Input g is local-energy coupling, not dimensionless λ.
translations.结果来自声子截断矩阵的精确对角化；需另查声子截断误差。数值残差小不意味着物理截断: Results come from exact diagonalization of a phonon-truncated matrix; phonon-cutoff errors require separate checks. Small residuals do not mean physical truncation is converged.
translations.扫描固定当前声子截断，各点只报告最高层概率；仅当前参数额外做相邻更高截断比较。扫: The scan fixes current phonon cutoff and reports only highest-level probabilities at each point. Only current parameters also compare a higher cutoff. Scan lines do not establish infinite-system transitions.
translations.对称体系的均匀电子密度可与电子—声子关联共存；不能因⟨n_0⟩=⟨n_1⟩就断言: Uniform symmetric density can coexist with electron– phonon  correlations; ⟨n_0⟩=⟨n_1⟩ does not rule out  polaron . Two sites do not define macroscopic  polaron  radii.
translations.简并基态按10⁻⁹ eV容差等权平均，条件位移在电子占据概率低于10⁻¹²时留空: Degenerate ground states are equally averaged within 10⁻⁹ eV; conditional displacements are blank below electron occupancy 10⁻¹². Electronic reduced purity measures mixedness and is not directly an entanglement measure for degenerate mixtures.
translations.这不是SSH键耦合、自洽晶格结构弛豫或EPW第一性原理计算；已有声子频率文件本身: This is neither SSH bond coupling, self-consistent lattice relaxation, nor EPW first-principles computation. A phonon frequency file alone does not supply coupling g.

translations.两个局域振子的声子数概率: Phonon-number probabilities of two local oscillators
translations.电子在哪里，振动云就怎样改变: The vibrational cloud follows electron location
translations.相同声子截断下的耦合扫描: Coupling scans at equal  phonon  cutoff
translations.振动云与电子离域的共同变化: Joint changes of the vibrational cloud and electron delocalization
translations.扫描中每个点都要检查截断: Check truncation at every scan point
translations.当前声子截断未通过相邻截断诊断，请提高截断或减小g/ℏω后比较；图中结果仅代表当: The current phonon cutoff fails adjacent-truncation diagnostics; increase it or reduce g/ℏω and compare. Plotted results describe only the current finite basis.
translations.耦合扫描中存在最高声子层概率不小于10⁻³的点；这些点不能按已收敛结果解读。: Some coupling-scan points have highest-phonon-level probability ≥10⁻³ and must not be treated as converged.
translations.相邻截断能量变化: Energy change at the adjacent cutoff
translations.耦合调制位点能；g单位eV、X无量纲。正g对应被占据振子的负位移。它不调制跃迁t: Coupling modulates site energy: g in eV, X dimensionless. Positive g gives negative occupied-oscillator displacement; hopping t is not modulated.
translations.固定电子所在站点后读取振动云；该关联可以存在于电子密度均匀的对称基态。分母小于1: Read the vibrational cloud conditioned on the electron’s site; this correlation can exist in a symmetric ground state with uniform electron density. Undefined when the denominator is below 10⁻¹².
translations.两个振子的总零点能ℏω已从Hamiltonian中省略，位移仍是量子算符；不代表: Total oscillator zero-point energy ℏω is omitted from H; displacements remain quantum operators, not absent zero-point fluctuations.
translations.相邻截断的能量差须连同局域量变化和最高声子层概率一起判断。当前参数做双截断，扫描: Judge adjacent-cutoff energy differences with local-observable changes and highest-level probabilities. Current parameters use two cutoffs; scans check highest-level probability only.
