translations.仅计算均匀、静态、局域平衡响应；平移部分不增加这些 q=0 张量约束。: Only uniform, static local-equilibrium response is calculated; translation parts add no constraints to these q=0 tensors.
translations.对称性允许某分量并不保证其非零；数值响应来自输入参数，不能据此预测材料常数。: An allowed component need not be nonzero. Numeric responses come from inputs and do not predict material constants.
translations.弹性正定性、介电稳定性与具体实验单位不由对称性保证；演示不拟合实验数据。: Symmetry guarantees neither elastic positivity, dielectric stability, nor experimental units; no data fitting.
translations.此处不处理耗散输运或频率相关光学张量，不能用本规则替代 Onsager 互易关系: Dissipative transport and frequency-dependent optical tensors are excluded; this rule cannot replace Onsager reciprocity.

translations.11,22,33,23,13,12 → 1,2,3,4,5,6；显示分量不含倍数: 11,22,33,23,13,12 → 1,2,3,4,5,6; displayed components contain no multiplicity factors, while response inputs use engineering shear strain

translations.Cr₂O₃ 示例假定低于 Néel 温度、低磁场、沿三重轴共线反铁磁的单畴 −3: The Cr₂O₃ example assumes a low-field, below-Néel-temperature collinear antiferromagnetic single domain −3′m′ along the threefold axis; the time-reversed domain reverses all of α. Temperature dependence and domain fractions are not fitted.

translations.Phonopy：准谐自由能、体积优化与热膨胀: Phonopy: quasiharmonic free energy, volume, expansion
translations.同胞归一化依据导入文件的显式声明；仅有自由能表不能独立核验晶胞、原子种类、原子对: Common-cell normalization relies on explicit import declarations; free-energy tables alone cannot independently verify cells, species, atom correspondence, q-mesh convergence or dynamical stability.
translations.αV、S 和 Cp 使用相邻三个温度的局部二次差分，首末温度不报告；请用更密温度: αV, S, Cp use local3-temperature quadratic differences, no endpoint values. Check denser T/V derivative convergence.
translations.每个声明一致的输入计算胞: Per consistently declared input calculation cell
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 须包含 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 个数值: ZXQD0DQXZ must contain ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ numbers
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ必须严格递增；不自动排序或合并重复点，以免错配数据: ZXQD0DQXZ must strictly increase; no automatic sorting/duplicate merging that could misalign data
translations.当前 preset 仅支持 einstein-volume 原创教学模型: The current preset supports only the original einstein-volume teaching model

translations.QHA 至少需要 3 个温度点；首末点不报告温度导数: QHA needs≥3 temperatures; no endpoint derivatives

translations.必须声明 cellBasis: same-input-cell，确认所有体积、静: Declare cellBasis: same-input-cell, confirming common cell normalization for all volumes and static/vibrational energies
translations.units 必须明确 volume: angstrom^3 和 staticEn: units must specify volume: angstrom^3/staticEnergy: eV/input-cell
translations.staticEnergies 必须与 volumes 一一对应；不得缺失体积点: staticEnergies must correspond one-to-one with volumes, without missing points
translations.矩阵导入未包含逐模式信息；结果仅反映所提供振动自由能，不能据此判断虚频或缺失模式: Matrix imports lack mode-resolved information; results reflect supplied vibrational free energies only and cannot establish imaginary frequencies or missing modes.
translations.体积采样区间过窄，不能稳定拟合: Volume-sampling interval is too narrow for a stable fit
translations.局部体积采样病态或近乎重复，拟合条件数过大: Ill-conditioned/near-duplicate local volumes; fit condition too large
translations.最低采样自由能位于体积区间边界；需要补充体积数据，未外推平衡体积。: The lowest sampled free energy is at a volume boundary; add volume data. Equilibrium volume is not extrapolated.
translations.拟合在采样最小值的相邻体积之间没有正曲率极小点；不能报告稳定平衡体积。: No positive-curvature minimum lies between volumes neighboring the sampled minimum; a stable equilibrium volume cannot be reported.
translations.局部拟合极小值高于最低原始采样能；拟合不能可靠描述该极小值。: Fitted minimum exceeds lowest raw sample; unreliable local fit.
translations.局部拟合最大残差超过 ZXQD0DQXZ eV/胞；导数可能对采样和拟合方式敏感: Maximum local-fit residual exceeds ZXQD0DQXZ eV/cell; derivatives may depend sensitively on sampling and fitting.
translations.原始体积数据出现多个局部极小值；本次仅拟合最低采样谷，单相连续导数未必适用。: Raw volumes have multiple local minima. Only the lowest sampled valley is fitted; continuous single-phase derivatives may not apply.
translations.source 须为 preset、matrix 或 thermal；单份 DOS: source must be preset/matrix/thermal; one DOS cannot determine expansion
translations.fit_window 不得大于实际体积点数: fit_window cannot exceed the actual volume count
translations.原创合成教学数据；参数用于观察体积—频率耦合，不代表 Si 或任何真实材料的第一: Original synthetic volume–frequency teaching data, not Si/real-material first-principles results.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ/ZXQD1DQXZ 个温度没有受采样区间支持的内点极小值，相: ZXQD0DQXZ/ZXQD1DQXZ temperatures lack an interior minimum supported by the sampled interval; their volumes, bulk moduli and derivatives remain blank.
translations.ZXQD0DQXZ 个温度含拟合或热力学警告，详见各温度结果；小残差不等于体积/: ZXQD0DQXZ temperatures have fitting/thermodynamic warnings; see individual results. Small residuals do not establish volume/temperature/q-mesh convergence.
translations.局部 ZXQD0DQXZ 次多项式，ZXQD1DQXZ 个体积点；仅限内点极小值: Local degree-ZXQD0DQXZ polynomial, ZXQD1DQXZ volumes; interior minima only
translations.G(T,p) = min_V [E_static(V) + F_vib(T,V): G(T,p) = min_V [E_static(V) + F_vib(T,V) + pV]; p is constant external hydrostatic pressure.
translations.体积、静态能与振动自由能必须采用同一计算胞；1 mol 是 N_A 个此计算胞，: Volumes and static/vibrational energies must share a calculation cell. One mole means N_A such cells, not automatically atoms or formula units.
translations.局部缩放坐标 x=(V−center)/scale 上最小二乘拟合，不是 Vin: Least squares in scaled x=(V−center)/scale, not Vinet/Birch–Murnaghan; coefficients ascend in x power.
translations.B_T = V ∂²F/∂V²；αV=(1/V)(∂V/∂T)_p；Cp=−T(: B_T = V ∂²F/∂V²; αV=(1/V)(∂V/∂T)_p; Cp=−T(∂²G/∂T²)_p. αV is volume expansion, not directly the linear-expansion coefficient of a general anisotropic crystal.
translations.本模块只做各向同性体积优化；不计算各向异性应变、强非谐频率重整化、电子有限温自由: Only isotropic volume optimization is performed. No anisotropic strain, strong anharmonic renormalization, finite-T electronic energy, magnetic entropy, interphase energies, or conductivity.
translations.正体模量只检验体积方向的机械曲率；不证明声子无虚频、剪切稳定或全局相稳定。: Positive bulk moduli check volume curvature, not  phonon  imaginary modes, shear, or global stability.
translations.必须严格递增；不自动排序或合并重复点，以免错配数据: must strictly increase; no automatic sorting/duplicate merging
translations.units.vibrationalFreeEnergy 须为 eV/input-: units.vibrationalFreeEnergy must be eV/input-cell or kJ/mol-input-cell

translations.各体积的模式积分比例、频率截断或 Γ 声学模式排除设置不同，不能将不一致的振动自: Mode-integration fractions, frequency cutoffs or Γ-acoustic exclusions differ between volumes; inconsistent vibrational free energies cannot be combined for fitting
translations.thermal 文件未提供模式积分计数，无法核验模式完整性；请独立确认所有体积的: Thermal files lack integrated-mode counts, so completeness cannot be checked. Independently verify stable phonon spectra and consistent integration at all volumes.
translations.thermal 文件使用了非零频率截止；结果保留这一近似。: Thermal files use nonzero cutoffs; retain this approximation.
translations.各体积的总模式数不同，可能采用了不同 q 网格；相同积分比例不证明网格收敛，需独: Total mode counts differ between volumes, possibly from different q meshes; equal integration fractions do not prove convergence, so independently verify free-energy accuracy.
translations.二次拟合未给出相同区间的极小值；拟合阶数收敛尚未确认。: Quadratic fitting gives no minimum in the same interval; convergence in fit order remains unconfirmed.
translations.eV/胞；导数可能对采样和拟合方式敏感。: eV/cell; derivatives may depend sensitively on sampling and fitting.
translations.数值导出的 Cp 为负；请核对输入的热力学稳定性、温度采样及体积拟合误差。: Numerically derived Cp is negative. Check thermodynamic stability, temperature sampling, and volume-fit errors.
translations.相邻温度的拟合窗口不相交，可能存在体积跳变；不报告跨越跳变的连续导数。: Adjacent fit windows do not overlap; possible volume jump, no continuous derivatives across it.
translations.个温度没有受采样区间支持的内点极小值，相应体积、体模量与导数留空。: temperatures lack an interior minimum supported by the sampled interval; their volumes, bulk moduli and derivatives remain blank.
translations.个温度含拟合或热力学警告，详见各温度结果；小残差不等于体积/温度/q 网格已收: temperatures have fitting/thermodynamic warnings; see individual results. Small residuals do not establish volume/temperature/q-mesh convergence.
translations.V、E_static、F_vib → 同一 natom 与同一胞: V, E_static, F_vib → the same natom and cell

translations.kJ/mol-input-cell 除以 96.485332… 转为 eV/in: Divide kJ/mol-input-cell by 96.485332… to obtain eV/input-cell; divide GPa·Å³ by 160.2176634 to obtain eV.
